title: AR / Spatial Computing Developer
description:
**About the Company**

Techylla is a fast-growing IT and consulting firm delivering SAP/ERP, data engineering, AI/ML, cloud, and full-stack solutions to clients across industries in the United States and India. Our teams work across the complete technology landscape—from enterprise systems and integration to data platforms and immersive applications—so specialists collaborate closely rather than working in silos. We value relationships, commitment, integrity, and collaboration, and we give our people the ownership and support to turn ambitious ideas into practical client outcomes.

**About the Role**

Techylla is looking for an experienced and passionate AR / Spatial Computing Developer who can turn a business brief into a reliable working product. You will help a team to build an iPad application designed to extend to AR, using spatial mapping.

**Responsibilities**

* Own the end-to-end design and delivery of the iPad AR application, balancing scope, quality, usability, schedule, and budget.
* Translate warehouse and logistics workflows into intuitive spatial-computing experiences for non-technical floor teams.
* Use ARKit, RealityKit, LiDAR, RoomPlan, and related Apple frameworks to map physical spaces and anchor information accurately to shelves, pallets, labels, and locations.
* Build reliable barcode and QR scanning workflows using Vision, VisionKit, or AVFoundation, including support for challenging lighting and operating conditions.
* Create clear, responsive interfaces in SwiftUI that minimise taps, visual clutter, and training needs.
* Integrate securely with enterprise APIs and back-end services using modern authentication patterns such as OAuth 2.0 or OpenID Connect.
* Design for intermittent connectivity, offline operation, data synchronisation, and graceful recovery in warehouse environments.
* Collaborate closely with the project lead, back-end and AI engineers, product stakeholders, and business subject-matter experts.
* Demonstrate progress weekly and deliver stable TestFlight builds, concise demo videos, and transparent status updates.
* Profile and optimise performance, battery use, memory, rendering, tracking stability, and device-specific behaviour.
* Document architecture, setup, key decisions, limitations, and a practical roadmap for extending the product to visionOS and other devices.
* Apply strong engineering practices, including modular design, testing, code review, source control, privacy, and secure handling of enterprise data.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree (B.Tech/B.E.) or master’s degree (M.Tech/M.E./M.S.) in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related technical field.
* 3+ years of professional native iOS development experience using Swift, with strong proficiency in SwiftUI.
* Hands-on experience building and demonstrating AR applications with ARKit and RealityKit.
* Experience with spatial anchors, scene understanding, ray casting, world tracking, and 3D content placement.
* Practical experience with on-device computer vision, barcode or QR scanning, and camera-based workflows.
* Experience integrating iOS applications with REST APIs, authentication services, and enterprise back ends.
* Strong understanding of asynchronous programming, application architecture, debugging, testing, and performance optimisation.
* Ability to convert ambiguous business requirements into scoped, testable, shippable product increments.
* Clear written and verbal communication, including the ability to explain technical trade-offs to non-technical stakeholders.
* Self-directed, dependable, and comfortable owning delivery in a fast-moving proof-of-concept environment.

**Required Skills**

* Professional native iOS development in Swift and SwiftUI.
* AR applications development with ARKit and RealityKit.
* Spatial anchors, scene understanding, ray casting, world tracking, and 3D content placement.
* On-device computer vision, barcode or QR scanning, and camera-based workflows.
* Integration of iOS applications with REST APIs, authentication services, and enterprise back ends.
* Asynchronous programming, application architecture, debugging, testing, and performance optimisation.
* Ability to convert ambiguous business requirements into scoped, testable, shippable product increments.
* Clear written and verbal communication, including the ability to explain technical trade-offs to non-technical stakeholders.
* Self-directed, dependable, and comfortable owning delivery in a fast-moving proof-of-concept environment.

**Preferred Skills**

* Experience with LiDAR scene reconstruction, RoomPlan, Reality Composer Pro, Metal, SceneKit, or Model I/O.
* Hands-on development for visionOS or Apple Vision Pro, including RealityView, immersive spaces, and shared Swift packages across iPadOS and visionOS.
* Experience designing AR interfaces for warehouses, manufacturing, field service, retail, or other industrial environments.
* Familiarity with 3D asset pipelines, USDZ, photogrammetry, occlusion, lighting, and spatial audio.
* Experience with offline-first data patterns, Core Data or SwiftData, background synchronisation, and resilient networking.
* Exposure to SAP, BTP, warehouse-management systems, or enterprise integration landscapes.
* Experience working in an IT services or consulting environment supporting client-facing delivery.
* Published App Store or TestFlight applications, open-source contributions, or a portfolio of relevant spatial-computing work.

**Required Skills**

* Languages and UI
* Swift, SwiftUI
* AR and Spatial Computing
* ARKit, RealityKit, RoomPlan, LiDAR, visionOS
* Computer Vision and Capture
* Vision, VisionKit, AVFoundation
* 3D and Content
* Reality Composer Pro, USDZ, SceneKit, Model

**Behavioral Attributes**

* Self-starter who can move fast with minimal onboarding — critical given the immediate-joiner requirement
* Strong ownership mentality — treats the product like it's their own
* Detail-oriented with a genuine eye for UI polish and user experience
* Comfortable working directly with clients and handling ambiguity
* Curious and current — actively follows the React/front-end ecosystem rather than working off outdated patterns

**Perks & Benefits**

* Competitive, industry-standard compensation with fast-tracked offers for the right candidate
* Hybrid work model – India, with flexibility to balance focus time and collaboration
* Comprehensive medical insurance coverage for you and your family
* Real growth path

title: TechnoFunctional MES Application Lead
description:
**Job Description:**
TechnoFunctional MES Application Lead
  
  

* Location: PAN India
* Number of Positions: 2
* Experience Required: 8–14 Years
* Work Mode: Hybrid

**Job Summary: (P3/P4)**
We are seeking an experienced TechnoFunctional MES Application Lead to own and drive the endtoend delivery and operational support of Körber PASX solutions on Azure AKS, ensuring timely, and highquality MES services within a regulated manufacturing environment. The role combines strong technical depth and functional understanding of MES processes to coordinate crossfunctional teams, manage integrations and dependencies, proactively resolve issues, and ensure validated, compliant, and reliable MES solutions that meet business, quality, and regulatory requirements.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Own the MES PASX tower (v3.3.x) across programs, ensuring platform stability, scalability and compliance in cloudbased AKS (Azure Kubernetes Services) environments.
* Define and govern MES architecture standards, integration patterns, deployment models and operational best practices for PASX on Azure.
* Ensure alignment of MES tower strategy with manufacturing IT, Digital Manufacturing roadmaps, ISA88/95 standards and enterprise IT governance.
* Act as the single point of accountability for MES PASX delivery, operations, quality and compliance.
* Lead endtoend MES PASX implementations and upgrades, from requirement gathering through configuration, qualification and final delivery.
* Ensure to Coordinate on rollouts and system upgrades for PASX application.
* Own MES Service Delivery Operations, ensuring high availability, performance, and adherence to SLAs.
* Govern 2ndlevel support operations for PASX, Azure, Kubernetes, and MES integrations.
* Lead Incident, Problem, Change and Release Management processes in line with ITIL.
* Proactively identify risks, recurring issues and improvement opportunities to ensure smooth operations.
* Provide technical leadership for PASX deployment and lifecycle management on AKS, including service pack installations and platform upgrades.
* Govern OS, application and platform patching (Windows/Linux) and ensure timely vulnerability remediation.
* Oversee Kubernetes, Linux and databaserelated activities, ensuring performance, resilience and availability of MES environments.
* Collaborate closely with enterprise Infrastructure, Cloud, Security and Network teams.
* Own and govern MES integrations with Level 2, Level 3, and Level 4 systems including SAP ERP, OSI PI, LIMS & Kepware/OPC.
* Ensure robust design, monitoring and support of DCS adapters, services and interfaces.
* Drive troubleshooting for complex crosssystem issues spanning MES, DCS, ERP, and shopfloor automation.
* Establish governance for MES PASX Users & Rights, Control Data & Profiles, Terminals, Printing, and Reporting, Production Units, WMS Master Data, Service & system configurations.
* Ensure data consistency, audit readiness, and alignment with validated system requirements.
* Ensure MES solutions comply with CSV, SDLC, 21 CFR Part 11, cGMP and GAMP requirements.
* Act as the primary interface with vendors such as Körber, Microsoft and system integrators.
* Manage vendor delivery, escalations and roadmap alignment.
* Collaborate closely with business stakeholders, plant teams, QA, infrastructure and enterprise IT leadership.
* Provide technical and functional leadership to MES engineers and support teams.
* Mentor team members on PASX functionality, cloud/K8s concepts, validation and integrations.
* Drive proactive collaboration, knowledge sharing, and operational excellence within the MES tower.
* Identify opportunities for automation, standardization and performance optimization within MES operations.

title: AVP , Quality Engineering (QE) Automation Architect  ( L11 )
description:
**Role Title :**
AVP , Quality Engineering (QE) Automation Architect ( L11 )
  
  
**Company Overview:**
Synchrony (NYSE: SYF) is a leading consumer financing company that has been at the heart of American commerce and opportunity for nearly a century. Synchrony delivers credit and banking products that empower tens of millions of consumers to improve their financial lives and access what matters most. Leveraging innovative solutions that are shaping the future of retail commerce, Synchrony supports the growth and success of some of the nation’s most respected brands, alongside hundreds of thousands of small and midsize businesses, including health and wellness providers. Committed to excellence in service and culture, Synchrony is proud to be named as #3 as a Great Place to Work® in India and is honored to be ranked the #1 Best Company to Work For® in the U.S. by Fortune magazine and Great Place to Work®. For more information, visit www.synchrony.com.
  
  
**Organizational Overview**
The Quality Engineering Center of Excellence (QE COE) is a centralized team of Quality Engineering Leaders and Test Architects, that standardizes, scales, and governs software quality, test automation, and best practices across the organization. This team works closely with the Leaders in the Engineering verticals and other cross functional teams who are the key stakeholders. This role will work closely with other peer Test Architects in the team under the leadership of the QE Leader to rollout and institutionalize the AI driven QE strategies and solutions conceptualized by the team, in partnership with the Application Teams.
  
  
**Role Summary/Purpose**
**Quality Engineering (QE) Automation Architect**
Drive the design and delivery of next-generation Quality Engineering solutions by blending proven testing methodologies with AI-powered approaches. This role will occasionally architect scalable testing frameworks, champion adoption of AI-assisted testing, and embed intelligent automation across the product development lifecycle and CI/CD pipelines to accelerate high-quality delivery.
  
  
As an SME in AI-enabled test automation engineering, this role will partner with peer architects and stakeholders to define strategy, recommend the optimal tool stack aligned to the application landscape, and resolve complex automation challenges—delivering best-in-class, enterprise-wide automation expansion solutions.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Architect and own scalable test automation frameworks for functional, regression, and non-functional testing; embed automation into CI/CD (Jenkins, GitHub, CloudBees) as required by the Application teams.
* Define and drive QE standards, best practices, and reusable libraries/patterns across engineering teams.
* Partner with QE leads in application teams to implement shift-left testing and quality-by-design.
* Design and implement AI-assisted testing solutions leveraging LLMs, RAG, and agentic workflows; lead prompt engineering and context design for reliable AI test agents (test generation, test data creation, defect triage/analysis).
* Drive adoption and standardization of modern automation tools/frameworks (e.g., Playwright, Selenium).
* Enable self-service automation and quality reporting dashboards for engineering teams.
* Act as a QE technical leader, run architecture reviews, mentor QE Engineers/Architects on AI-driven quality patterns and tools, and resolve complex automation challenges.
* Create playbooks, training, and rollout plans; continuously evaluate/pilot emerging QE technologies and measure adoption and impact.

**Required Skills/Knowledge**

* Experience: 12+ years in Software Quality Engineering, including 3+ years in test architecture and framework design.
* Automation Tools: Hands-on expertise in Playwright and/or Selenium, REST API testing, and modern JavaScript/TypeScript or Python automation frameworks.
* AI-Assisted Testing: Working knowledge of LLMs and context design for QE use cases.
* Experience in providing AI-assisted solutions for functional, UAT, performance and security testing.
* AI Tooling: Experience applying AI tools for test case generation, code review support, and defect triage.
* Agentic Workflows: Understanding of agentic AI patterns to build autonomous test agents and end-to-end workflows.
* Integration: Ability to integrate AI solutions with existing business processes and enterprise IT infrastructure
* Communication & stakeholder management: Align and influence stakeholders through clear, concise communication.
* System thinking & architecture design: Design scalable QE architectures with end-to-end perspective.
* Problem formulation & solution design: Turn vague problems into measurable, practical solutions.

**Desired Skills/Knowledge**

* Experience designing and building GenAI platforms.
* Exposure to cloud ecosystems such as AWS and Azure.
* Proven ability to integrate test automation into CI/CD toolchains (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, CloudBees).

**Eligibility Criteria**

* Bachelor’s Degree and a minimum of 12 + years of experience in Information Technology or Engineering.

**Work Timings**
2:00PM to 11:00 PM IST
  
  
This role qualifies for Enhanced Flexibility offered in Synchrony India and will require the incumbent to be available between 06:00 AM Eastern Time – 11:30 AM Eastern Time (timings are anchored to US Eastern hours and will adjust twice a year locally). This window is for meetings with India and US teams. The remaining hours will be flexible for the employee to choose. Exceptions may apply periodically due to business needs) We are proud to offer flexibility at Synchrony. Our way of working allows you the option to work from home or workspaces in our Regional Engagement Hubs—Hyderabad, Bengaluru, Pune, Kolkata, or Delhi/NCR. Occasionally you may be required to commute or travel to Hyderabad or one of the Regional Engagement Hubs for in person engagement activities such as business or team meetings, trainings, and culture events
  
  
**For Internal Applicants**

* Understand the criteria or mandatory skills required for the role, before applying
* Inform your manager and HRM before applying for any role on Workday
* Ensure that your professional profile is updated (fields such as education, prior experience, other skills) and it is mandatory to upload your updated resume (Word or PDF format)
* Must not be any corrective action plan (First Formal/Final Formal )

* L09+ Employees can apply

title: Systems Analyst
description:
**About Xerox Holdings Corporation**
For more than 100 years, Xerox has continually redefined the workplace experience. Harnessing our leadership position in office and production print technology, we’ve expanded into software and services to sustainably power the hybrid workplace of today and tomorrow. Today, Xerox is continuing its legacy of innovation to deliver client-centric and digitally-driven technology solutions and meet the needs of today’s global, distributed workforce. From the office to industrial environments, our differentiated business and technology offerings and financial services are essential workplace technology solutions that drive success for our clients. At Xerox, we make work, work. Learn more about us at www.xerox.com.
  
  
**Job Function:**
The role is responsible for the technical delivery, data architecture, and operational support of Channel Data Management (CDM) solutions within a complex enterprise environment, with a strong focus on database design, SQL development, and ETL processes.
  
  
This position defines and delivers high‑value CDM enhancements while ensuring data integrity, system performance, and scalability. The role requires deep expertise in relational databases, data modeling, and query optimization, as well as hands-on experience designing, developing, and maintaining ETL pipelines to support data ingestion, transformation, and integration across multiple systems.
  
  
This position partners closely with IT, Sales Operations, and Data Engineering teams to manage end-to-end data solutions—from requirements gathering and backlog prioritization to data pipeline development, production support, and analytics enablement. The role ensures high-quality, reliable data flows across platforms while translating complex technical and data concepts into actionable insights for both technical and non‑technical stakeholders.
  
  
The CDM System Analyst should be highly motivated and passionate about data systems, database technologies, and scalable application architecture. The ideal candidate brings strong experience in SQL scripting, data transformation logic, performance tuning, and troubleshooting data issues across distributed systems. This role requires full ownership of data processes and pipelines, with a commitment to continuously enhancing the CDM ecosystem, improving data quality, and strengthening application and data infrastructure resiliency.
  
  
**Duties and Responsibilities:**

* System Operations, Monitoring & Incident Management
* Provide technical expertise to manage and support complex IT architectures supporting CDM solutions.
* Perform daily CDM system monitoring, including data validation, batch/job execution, and overall system health.
* Troubleshoot and resolve data quality and system issues identified through monitoring activities.
* Manage incidents and changes in alignment with the ITIL framework, including escalation to IT teams and tracking through resolution.
* Maintain, test, and continuously improve business and system operations to ensure stability and performance of 24x7 applications.
* Processes, Technical Solutions, Data & Analytics Enablement

* Develop SQL-based solutions to support reporting and analytics needs, including Power BI datasets and reports.
* Build and maintain Business Objects Universes and reports.
* Design and deliver solutions using Microsoft Power BI and Power Platform tools.
* Maintain a holistic view of CDM processes and users to assess functional impacts across configuration, workflows, integrations, and reporting.
* Apply deep understanding of CDM business processes and related enterprise systems, including ERP, PLM, CRM, and the Microsoft ecosystem.
* Stakeholder Collaboration, Communication & Enablement
* Work closely with technology and operations teams to ensure successful, sustainable delivery of CDM systems, including transitions to IT operations.
* Provide regular project and operational updates (weekly/monthly), and confidently brief executive audiences to support informed, proactive decision-making.
* Report risks, issues, and progress to IT leadership, escalating as appropriate.
* Develop, deliver, and support training for CDM operations and key user teams, enabling adoption and effective system usage.
* Effectively communicate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

**Experience and Background:**
**Work History:**

* 5+ years of experience in designing solutions and defining requirements for CDM platforms and complex IT systems, including hands-on experience with databases, SQL, ETL processes, and related data systems..
* Excellent communication skills and customer service skills
* Must have strong problem-solving ability, critical thinking skills, creative/innovative thinking, attention to detail, and previous systems/business analyst experience.
* Must show positive attitude, strong self-motivation, ability to meet deadlines, and ability to determine appropriate sense of urgency.
* Good understanding of software development life cycles.

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Information Systems or closely related field.
* Expertise in Data warehouse and ETL tools like BODS (Business Objects Data Services), DataStage, Business Objects, AWS Aurora and AWS Redshift.
* Must have knowledge in IT Development, Production support or Operations area.
* Extensive working experience in SQL Query or other programming languages.
* Must have knowledge in Microsoft office tools, particularly Excel, VBA and Access.
* Nice to have knowledge of web applications, portals and document management tools.

**Skills:**

title: Principal Enterprise Architect
description:
**Enterprise Architect - Cloud & AI**
**Role Overview**
Jumio is not just processing transactions; we are pioneering the future of identity intelligence. To lead this transformation, you serve as a visionary
**AI Adoption Catalyst and Systems Architect**
, redefining our technical landscape. In this role, you aren’t a traditional gatekeeper—you are a
**Developer Advocate**
and mission-driven leader. You take end-to-end ownership of our architecture, positioning machine learning and GenAI at the heart of our DNA. Leveraging your deep expertise in AWS and cloud-native engineering, you provide the engine that empowers our developers to innovate at lightning speed, ensuring our multi-tenant SaaS platform remains the global benchmark for performance and scale.
  
  
This is a mandate for a technical doer who thrives on the front lines. Building on our strong, scalable cloud foundation, you will actively champion the adoption of GenAI tools across the software development lifecycle while driving continuous architectural improvement, evolution, and operational cost optimization. Your proven experience in AWS is the toolkit you use to clear architectural roadblocks and optimize performance, enabling engineering teams to move with unprecedented velocity.
  
  
As a strategic technical leader who stays close to the code, you inspire an AI-First culture. You bridge the gap between visionary enterprise design and pragmatic execution, driving cross-departmental impact while fostering self-service capabilities and cloud efficiency to ensure that as Jumio grows, our technology scales predictably and elegantly.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**End-to-End System Architecture & Optimization**

* Own the technical vision for scalable, high-performance, cost-efficient systems.
* Define modern architecture patterns that enable growth, high TPS, and seamless scaling.
* Architect and optimize multi-tenant SaaS platforms, ensuring configurability and performance.
* Design self-service capabilities to reduce engineering overhead (e.g., self-service workflow designer, self-service rules engine, self-service reporting).
* Lead cloud cost efficiency initiatives, optimizing infrastructure, model execution, and compute resources.
* Collaborate closely with AWS Support and Solution Architects to optimize infrastructure and leverage cutting-edge cloud capabilities.

**Data & AI Infrastructure**

* Architect high-scale, distributed data processing pipelines for batch and real-time workloads.
* Optimize data storage, retrieval, and processing layers to enhance system performance and reduce cost.
* Enable data self-service for analytics, ML, and real-time business use cases.
* Ensure data governance, security, and compliance across all systems.

**Technical Leadership & Hands-on Architecture**

* Guide engineering teams on architectural best practices and pragmatic execution.
* Coach teams on scalable microservices, event-driven architectures, and cloud-native patterns.
* Practice "Architecting by Example" through technical prototyping and proof-of-concepts to validate architectural decisions.

**GenAI Acceleration & Architectural Advocacy**

* You serve as the AI Adoption Catalyst and engineering champion, actively partnering with developers and business units to integrate LLMs and agentic workflows that securely hyper-automate the development lifecycle.
* You clear roadblocks and deploy agile architectural guardrails that empower teams to experiment rapidly with automated AI tools, building a self-service AI culture while maintaining rigorous cost-performance optimization.
* Your leadership evolves architectural governance into a collaborative platform for ensuring system-wide coherence, security, and world-class scalability.

**Architectural Governance & ARC Leadership**

* Lead the Jumio Architecture Review Council (ARC) to drive cross-functional alignment and the evolution of our technical landscape.
* Establish and enforce architectural standards, ensuring consistency, security, and scalability across all product teams.
* Facilitate cross-team architectural reviews to identify technical debt, drive alignment, and ensure strategic coherence.
* Serve as the primary decision-maker for complex architectural trade-offs, balancing immediate delivery needs with long-term system health.
* Mentor engineering leadership on architectural best practices and standardized decision-making processes.

**Who You Are**

* Strategic Visionary—you connect long-term business goals with robust technical roadmaps.
* Ultra-technical—you design, build, and optimize systems with a hands-on approach.
* System-First Thinker—you prioritize architecture, efficiency, and scale in every decision.
* Cloud-Native Expert—you utilize your deep AWS knowledge to optimize costs while improving system performance.
* Pragmatic Decision Maker—your impact-driven solutions ensure technical excellence without sacrificing speed.
* Builder’s Mentality—you thrive on automation, self-service, and reducing engineering toil through GenAI adoption.
* Growth-Oriented Mentor—you teach, coach, and elevate the engineering teams through architectural advocacy.

**Must-Have Skills & Experience**

* 12+ years of hands-on experience in system architecture, data engineering, cloud engineering, or technical leadership roles.
* Experience with multi-tenant architectures and designing frameworks for configurable SaaS platforms.
* Deep, hands-on expertise in AWS (e.g., EKS, IAM, Lambda, networking) is required; professional experience with GCP is a strong plus.
* Strong experience with distributed systems, microservices, event-driven architectures, and caching strategies.
* Hands-on knowledge of AI/ML model execution—understanding model inference performance, cost trade-offs, and optimization strategies.
* Proficiency in high-scale transactional systems.
* Experience with infrastructure automation (Terraform, CI/CD, Kubernetes, Docker).
* Strong coding skills (Expert in Java, Strong in Python, Knowledgeable in JavaScript/TypeScript & Kotlin).
* Strong experience leading architectural review processes and fostering engineering standards.
* Proven expertise in integrating GenAI and ML methodologies into the software development lifecycle.
* Proven ability in strategic stakeholder management and complex financial/TCO (Total Cost of Ownership) analysis for enterprise technology.

**Nice-to-Have Skills**

* Deep Apache Spark expertise (execution model, shuffle, Catalyst/Tungsten, memory, AQE, Structured Streaming state) applied to architecture decisions.
* Deep expertise in one cloud (AWS, Azure or GCP) as it applies to Databricks, plus hands-on project experience in a second.

description:
**About Xerox Holdings Corporation**
For more than 100 years, Xerox has continually redefined the workplace experience. Harnessing our leadership position in office and production print technology, we’ve expanded into software and services to sustainably power the hybrid workplace of today and tomorrow. Today, Xerox is continuing its legacy of innovation to deliver client-centric and digitally-driven technology solutions and meet the needs of today’s global, distributed workforce. From the office to industrial environments, our differentiated business and technology offerings and financial services are essential workplace technology solutions that drive success for our clients. At Xerox, we make work, work. Learn more about us at www.xerox.com.
  
  
**Overview:**
Software Test Engineer (Functional) is responsible for end-to-end functional testing of complex enterprise-level software systems in cloud environments involving multiple applications and technologies. This role analyzes requirements, develops comprehensive test scenarios, executes testing, manages defects, and collaborates across teams to support software quality. The position offers an opportunity to work with API testing, automation, business intelligence, cloud technologies, and complex enterprise systems.
  
  
**Why Join This Team:**

* Work with complex enterprise-level applications and cloud technologies.
* Collaborate with business stakeholders and developers across multiple teams.
* Apply functional, API, automation, BI, and cloud testing experience.
* Gain exposure to technologies including IoT and AI/ML.
* Contribute to software quality through end-to-end testing and continuous collaboration.

**What You Will Do:**

* Analyze application features and requirements to identify end-to-end functional test scenarios and develop test cases.
* Execute functional tests, document defects, track issues through closure, and prepare test summary reports.
* Interpret business and technical diagrams, organize complex information, and use it to develop effective test strategies.
* Perform API, automation, BI, and cloud-related testing, including the use of automation tools such as Selenium.
* Collaborate with business stakeholders and development teams to understand requirements, troubleshoot issues, and support quality throughout the software development lifecycle.

**What You Need to Succeed:**

* 2 to 4 years of relevant experience as a Test Engineer, including functional testing of enterprise-level software systems.
* BE/BTech, preferably in Computer Science and Engineering or Information Technology, with a minimum of 70 percent marks as specified for this position.
* Experience with API testing, Selenium or similar automation tools, BI, cloud environments, and defect management tools.
* Knowledge of developing test strategies for complex enterprise systems; exposure to Agile Scrum and other software development lifecycles is beneficial.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, troubleshooting, and communication skills; knowledge of IoT and AI/ML is an added advantage.

**SAP S/4HANA Condition Contract Management (CCM)**

**Sales & Distribution (SD)**
and
**Pricing**
. In this role, you will lead enhancement deliveries, drive continuous process improvements, and provide robust L2/L3 production support to ensure seamless business operations and Order-to-Cash (O2C) integration.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Enhancements, Projects & Business Analysis
* Enhancement Delivery: Lead and deliver enhancements in CCM processes, including designing new contract types, complex settlement logic, and business-specific rebate models.
* Requirement Gathering: Engage with business stakeholders to translate functional requirements into comprehensive Functional Specifications (FS) for RICEF objects.
* System Configuration: Configure condition contract types, pricing conditions, settlement settings, and seamless integration points with financial modules.
* Technical Collaboration: Partner closely with ABAP/technical teams during custom development, code walk-throughs, unit testing, and deployment.
* Testing & Deployment: Drive System Integration Testing (SIT) and User Acceptance Testing (UAT) cycles, ensuring defect-free releases into production environments.
* Process Optimization: Identify opportunities for automation and process optimization across CCM and pricing frameworks.
* Application Support & Maintenance (L2/L3)
* Production Support: Provide high-quality L2/L3 support for SAP S/4HANA CCM processes, ensuring strict SLA adherence and minimal operational disruption.
* Issue Resolution: Diagnose and resolve complex incidents related to rebate processing, settlement runs, accrual postings, and pricing inconsistencies.
* Root Cause Analysis (RCA): Perform in-depth RCA on recurring issues and implement preventive, sustainable fixes.
* ITSM Ticket Management: Manage incidents, service requests, and problem tickets efficiently within enterprise ITSM tools (e.g., ServiceNow).
* Period-End Operations: Monitor, validate, and troubleshoot period-end settlement runs and financial postings.
* Cross-Module Integration & Governance
* SD/FI Alignment: Collaborate effectively with SD and FI/CO teams to resolve cross-functional issues and ensure accurate O2C financial integration.
* Pricing Accuracy: Leverage deep SD and Pricing expertise to maintain calculation schema integrity and pricing determination rules.
* Change Governance: Strictly adhere to transport management, release governance, and change management procedures (CAB approvals) for all system changes.
* Knowledge Management: Maintain accurate functional design documentation, standard operating procedures (SOPs), and conduct Knowledge Transfer (KT) sessions for peer teams.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**
Technical & Functional Expertise
  
  

* SAP CCM: 4+ years of focused experience configuring and supporting S/4HANA Condition Contract Management (Customer/Vendor Rebates, Chargebacks, Accruals, and Settlements).
* SAP SD & Pricing: Strong expertise in SD core processes (O2C), pricing procedures, condition technique, access sequences, and condition types.
* SAP FI Integration: Working knowledge of G/L accounting, account determination, split settlements, and revenue recognition impacts.
* RICEF Development: Proven track record in creating detailed functional designs for custom reports, interfaces, enhancements, and forms.
* ITSM & Tools: Hands-on experience with ServiceNow, Solution Manager, ChaRM, or similar change control frameworks.

* Experience: 8–10 years of SAP consulting experience across both Application Maintenance (Support) and Enhancement/Implementation projects.
* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Business Administration, Engineering, or a related discipline.

Soft Skills & Competencies

* Communication: Clear, concise written and verbal communication skills for engaging with both business key users and technical developers.

title: Senior Integration Solutions Engineer
description:
**Location:**
Kolkata, India
  
  
**Function:**
(DEAI HV) Product
  
  
**Requisition ID:**
R0137531
  
  
**Our Company**
We're Hitachi Vantara, the data foundation trusted by the world's innovators. Our resilient, high-performance data infrastructure means that customers - from banks to theme parks - can focus on achieving the incredible with data. If you've seen the Las Vegas Sphere, you've seen just one example of how we empower businesses to automate, optimize, innovate - and wow their customers. Right now, we're laying the foundation for our next wave of growth. We're looking for people who love being part of a diverse, global team - and who get excited about making a real-world impact with data.
  
  
**Role Overview**
The Senior Integration Solutions Engineer is responsible for architecting, validating, and documenting enterprise solutions leveraging S3-compatible object storage. This role works across data protection, analytics, AI/ML, search, and modern data lakehouse platforms to ensure solution interoperability, performance, scalability, and operational excellence. The engineer functions as a technical authority, designing validation strategies, developing performance benchmarks, troubleshooting complex environments, and publishing best-practice guidance for customers and partners.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Solution Architecture & Validation**

* Validate partner solutions including data protection, analytics, observability, search, and data lake platforms.
* Design and validate end-to-end reference architectures leveraging S3-compatible object storage for data protection, analytics, search, AI/ML, and data lake workloads.
* Evaluate emerging technologies and identify strategic integration opportunities for object storage platforms.
* Define validation methodologies that accurately reflect real-world customer deployment scenarios.
* Work directly with engineering, product management, partners, and field teams to ensure successful solution integration and deployment.
* Serve as a subject matter expert for object storage integration patterns, performance characteristics, and best practices.

**Integration & Performance Testing**

* Develop and execute comprehensive integration, interoperability, scalability, and performance test plans.
* Design benchmark tests that characterize throughput, latency, concurrency, and scalability under production-scale workloads.
* Build automated validation frameworks and test environments that improve testing efficiency and coverage.
* Identify performance bottlenecks across storage, network, compute, application, and infrastructure layers.

**Troubleshooting & Root Cause Analysis**

* Investigate complex issues spanning distributed applications, object storage systems, networking, operating systems, and cloud-native technologies.
* Analyze logs, traces, metrics, and telemetry data to determine root causes and recommend corrective actions.
* Reproduce field and customer-reported issues and work with development teams to validate resolutions.
* Provide technical leadership during escalations involving partner integrations and strategic customer environments.
* Publish validated reference architectures, deployment guides, solution briefs, and technical whitepapers.
* Develop sizing guidance, architecture recommendations, and performance tuning documentation.
* Present technical findings to customers, partners, sales engineers, and executive stakeholders.

**Required Qualifications**

* Experience designing, validating, or supporting enterprise-scale data platform, storage, or cloud infrastructure solutions.
* Strong background in integration testing, performance testing, or solution validation.
* Proven troubleshooting experience with distributed applications and multi-tier architectures.
* Experience with object storage technologies and S3-compatible APIs.
* Strong analytical skills and ability to investigate complex technical challenges independently.
* Excellent written communication skills with experience creating technical documentation.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with Commvault, Veeam, Cohesity, Rubrik, or other data protection platforms.
* Experience with Elasticsearch, OpenSearch, Splunk, or large-scale search and observability platforms.
* Experience with Apache Spark, Kafka, Trino, Iceberg, Delta Lake, Starburst, Databricks, or similar data analytics technologies.
* Familiarity with AI/ML data pipelines and data lake architectures.
* Experience with Kubernetes, Docker, and cloud-native environments.
* Experience authoring technical whitepapers, benchmark reports, and reference architectures.
* Experience presenting technical findings to customers and executive audiences.
* Strong knowledge of Linux, networking, and system administration concepts.
* Proficiency in Python, scripting, or test automation development.

**About Us**
We're a global team of innovators. Together, we harness engineering excellence and passion for insight to co-create meaningful solutions to complex challenges. We turn organizations into data-driven leaders that can make a positive impact on their industries and society. If you believe that innovation can inspire the future, this is the place to fulfil your purpose and achieve your potential.
  
  
**Fostering innovation through diverse perspectives**
Hitachi is a global company operating across a wide range of industries and regions. One of the things that sets Hitachi apart is the diversity of our business and people, which drives our innovation and growth.
  
  
We are committed to building an inclusive culture based on mutual respect and merit-based systems. We believe that when people feel valued, heard, and safe to express themselves, they do their best work.
  
  
**How We Look After You**
We help take care of your today and tomorrow with industry-leading benefits, support, and services that look after your holistic health and wellbeing. We're also champions of life balance and offer flexible arrangements that work for you (role and location dependent). We're always looking for new ways of working that bring out our best, which leads to unexpected ideas. So here, you'll experience a sense of belonging, and discover autonomy, freedom, and ownership as you work alongside talented people you enjoy sharing knowledge with.

Specialist - Application Security
  
  
**Kolkata, West Bengal, India | Workplace Type: On-Site | Job Type: Regular / Permanent / Unlimited / FTE | Reference Code: req32550**
It's about Being What's next. What's in it for you?
  
  
The Specialist in this position will perform Web, API and mobile application security testing; validate risks and provide actionable remediation guidance.
  
  
At Linde, employees can enjoy a range of benefits that make the workplace comfortable and enjoyable. title: SAP PM CS
description:
Job Description: SAP S/4HANA Service Management Lead / Senior Functional Consultant
  
  
Role Overview
  
  
We are seeking a highly experienced and results-driven
**SAP S/4HANA Service Management Lead / Senior Functional Consultant**
with
**5 to 12 years**
of expertise across SAP Customer Service (CS), Service Management (SM), and S/4HANA Service.
  
  
In this role, you will be responsible for designing, configuring, and implementing end-to-end Service Management processes in an
**SAP S/4HANA Cloud, Private Edition (PCE) / RISE with SAP**
environment. You will bridge business requirements and functional architecture, manage cloud service governance, enable AI-driven service insights, and drive continuous optimization across the full service lifecycle.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Solution Design & Implementation
* Design, configure, and deploy S/4HANA Service Management processes across the entire service lifecycle: Engage, Sell, Contract, Plan, Schedule, Execute, Invoice, and Analyze.
* Map end-to-end business requirements to standard S/4HANA Service capabilities, including service quotations, service orders, service contracts, spare parts logistics, resource planning, billing, and analytics.
* Drive adoption of the latest S/4HANA PCE release innovations (e.g., service team determination, advanced execution processes, Fiori applications, and AI-powered service intelligence).
* S/4HANA Private Edition (PCE) Governance
* Operate effectively within the SAP S/4HANA PCE Shared Responsibility Model between the client and SAP Enterprise Cloud Services (ECS).
* Liaise with SAP for system-level operational tasks (e.g., infrastructure management, backups, maintenance, and upgrade administration).
* Lead client-side functional responsibilities, including business process configuration, functional validation, regression testing, and process governance based on SAP’s PCE Roles and Responsibilities framework.
* Service Order & Contract Management
* Configure and maintain service contract structures, recurring service billing plans, and auto-renewal mechanisms.
* Enable flexible billing scenarios, including Resource-Related Billing (RRB), Time & Material (T&M), and Fixed-Price billing models.
* Leverage modern platform features such as service contract template cloning and mass contract change capabilities.
* Service Planning, Execution & Logistics Integration
* Set up and optimize workforce planning, resource allocation, dispatching, and field service workflows.
* Configure plant and storage location parameters within service transactions to support multi-plant and multi-location service execution.
* Direct cross-module functional integration between service transactions and procurement (MM), inventory management, shipping, plant maintenance (PM), and follow-on financial postings.
* Data Migration, Testing & Integration
* Oversee data preparation, cleansing, transformation, and validation for service master data, active service contracts, and open service orders.
* Utilize the SAP S/4HANA Migration Cockpit and standard transition tools tailored for service artifacts.
* Coordinate functional and technical integrations across CRM, SAP Field Service Management (FSM), SAP CS, core logistics, and Finance (FI/CO).
* AI, Analytics & Continuous Process Improvement
* Implement embedded AI capabilities (e.g., Joule-assisted summaries, intelligent confirmations, and predictive service insights).
* Design custom Fiori dashboards, operational reports, and KPIs to monitor service performance and profitability.
* Guide business stakeholders through continuous improvement initiatives and the adoption of periodic SAP release features.
* Stakeholder Management & Documentation
* Facilitate requirements-gathering workshops, author detailed functional specifications (FS), and map target-state business process flows.
* Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams spanning Logistics, Procurement, Finance, and Sales.
* Create training collateral, deliver end-user training, and lead hypercare support during deployment phases.

**Required Skills & Technical Expertise**

* Experience: 5–12 years of hands-on experience in SAP CS / SM / S/4HANA Service functional consulting.
* Core Module Competency: Comprehensive knowledge of S/4HANA Service (PCE) core functionality (Service Orders, Service Contracts, Resource-Related Billing, Invoicing, and Execution Logistics).
* Cloud Architecture: Clear operational understanding of the SAP PCE operating model, RISE with SAP frameworks, and cloud service boundary matrices.
* User Experience & Extensibility: Proficiency with modern SAP Fiori apps, standard OData APIs, and functional extensibility options.
* Integration Touchpoints: Strong cross-functional integration experience with PM, SD, MM, FI/CO, and SAP FSM.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Practical project experience with RISE with SAP S/4HANA Cloud, Private Edition implementations or migrations.
* Hands-on knowledge of SAP upgrade governance and release management protocols in PCE environments.
* Official SAP Certification in S/4HANA Service or related SAP functional modules.

**Soft Skills**

* Exceptional verbal and written communication skills with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
* Strong consulting mindset with a proven ability to translate business strategy into technical solution designs.
* Proactive problem-solving capabilities and experience leading cross-functional delivery teams.

title: Mid & Senior Informatica IDMC Developer
description:
Job Description – Mid & Senior Informatica IDMC Developer

**Experience:**
5–15 Years

**Employment Type:**
Full-Time

**Work Location:**
Remote

**Notice Period:**
Immediate Joiners Preferred

About the Role

We are seeking experienced
**Informatica IDMC Developers**
with strong hands-on expertise in Informatica Intelligent Data Management Cloud (IDMC), Cloud Data Integration (CDI), Cloud Data Quality (CDQ), and cloud-based ETL/ELT development.

The ideal candidate should have extensive experience designing, developing, configuring, and maintaining enterprise data integration solutions using Informatica IDMC/IICS.

This is a hands-on development role requiring strong knowledge of cloud data integration, complex mapping development, data quality, workflow orchestration, SQL, and production support.

Additional exposure to
**Informatica MDM Hub Console and ActiveVOS workflow development**
will be considered an added advantage.

Key Responsibilities

1. Informatica IDMC Development & Configuration

* Design, develop, configure, and maintain data integration solutions using Informatica IDMC/IICS.
* Work extensively with Cloud Data Integration (CDI), including mappings, mapping tasks, taskflows, and transformations.
* Develop complex ETL/ELT pipelines to integrate data from multiple cloud and on-premises sources.
* Configure source-to-target mappings, reusable components, parameterization, and dynamic mappings.
* Develop incremental and full-load data integration processes.
* Configure and maintain Informatica Secure Agent, runtime environments, connections, and scheduling.
* Troubleshoot mapping failures, integration issues, and data processing errors.
* Optimize IDMC mappings and taskflows for performance and scalability.

2. Cloud Data Integration (CDI)

* Develop and maintain complex CDI mappings using Lookup, Joiner, Expression, Aggregator, Filter, Router, and other transformations.
* Design reusable mappings and parameterized integration processes.
* Configure taskflows, scheduling, dependencies, and error-handling mechanisms.
* Implement data synchronization between cloud applications, databases, and enterprise systems.
* Develop and optimize high-volume data processing solutions.
* Monitor integration jobs and resolve execution failures.

3. Cloud Data Quality (CDQ/IDQ)

* Develop and maintain data quality mappings, cleansing processes, standardization, and validation rules.
* Perform data profiling and identify data quality issues across multiple source systems.
* Configure reusable data quality assets, rule specifications, and transformations.
* Implement data deduplication, parsing, standardization, and enrichment processes.
* Work with reference data and address validation capabilities.
* Integrate data quality processes into IDMC pipelines to ensure data accuracy and consistency.

4. Integration & API Development

* Develop and support integrations between IDMC and upstream/downstream enterprise applications.
* Work with REST/SOAP APIs, web services, and cloud application integrations.
* Support batch and real-time data integration requirements.
* Configure and troubleshoot data publishing and synchronization processes.
* Work with relational and cloud databases such as Oracle, SQL Server, and Snowflake.
* Troubleshoot connectivity failures, integration errors, and performance issues.

5. Production Support & Performance Optimization

* Monitor IDMC mappings, taskflows, integrations, and scheduled jobs.
* Analyze and resolve production issues related to CDI, CDQ, and data processing.
* Perform root-cause analysis and implement permanent fixes.
* Optimize mappings, SQL queries, transformations, and integration workflows.
* Manage Secure Agent-related issues and runtime configurations.
* Support deployment, release management, migration, and environment configuration.
* Coordinate with database, infrastructure, application, and business teams to resolve technical issues.

Required Skills & Experience

* 5–15 years of overall IT/data management experience, with significant hands-on development experience in Informatica IDMC/IICS.
* Strong expertise in Informatica Cloud Data Integration (CDI).
* Hands-on experience developing complex mappings, mapping tasks, transformations, and taskflows.
* Strong understanding of Informatica IDMC architecture and cloud integration capabilities.
* Experience with Informatica Cloud Data Quality (CDQ) or Informatica Data Quality (IDQ).
* Experience configuring and troubleshooting Informatica Secure Agent.
* Strong understanding of ETL/ELT concepts, data warehousing, and data integration architecture.
* Strong SQL skills with experience in Oracle, SQL Server, Snowflake, or similar databases.
* Experience integrating cloud and on-premises applications.
* Knowledge of REST/SOAP APIs and web-service integrations.
* Experience with parameterization, scheduling, error handling, and performance optimization.
* Good troubleshooting, debugging, and production support capabilities.
* Ability to independently develop, configure, test, and deploy IDMC solutions.

Good to Have – Informatica MDM & ActiveVOS

Candidates with additional hands-on experience in the following areas will be preferred:

**Informatica MDM Hub Console**

* Experience working with Informatica Multidomain MDM and MDM Hub Console.
* Knowledge of Base Objects, Landing Tables, Staging Tables, Packages, Queries, and Mappings.
* Understanding of Match/Merge, Trust, Survivorship, and Consolidation Rules.
* Exposure to Business Entity Services (BES) and MDM integration processes.
* Experience integrating IDMC pipelines with Informatica MDM solutions.

**ActiveVOS Workflow Development**

* Hands-on exposure to ActiveVOS workflow development and configuration.
* Experience developing data stewardship, approval, and exception-handling workflows.
* Understanding of ActiveVOS tasks, business processes, notifications, and assignments.
* Knowledge of ActiveVOS integration with Informatica MDM Hub and Business Entity Services.
* Ability to troubleshoot workflow failures and integration issues.

*Note: MDM Hub Console and ActiveVOS experience are desirable skills and are not mandatory for this position. Strong hands-on IDMC development experience remains the primary selection criterion.*

Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate should be:

* A hands-on Informatica IDMC/IICS Developer, not purely an administrator or support resource.
* Strong in CDI mapping development, taskflows, transformations, and ETL/ELT processes.
* Experienced in cloud data integration and data quality implementation.
* Comfortable working independently within the Informatica IDMC environment.
* Able to understand complex business requirements and translate them into technical integration solutions.
* Strong in SQL, troubleshooting, debugging, performance tuning, and production support.
* Capable of collaborating with business, data engineering, application, and data governance teams.
* Preferably exposed to Informatica MDM Hub Console and ActiveVOS workflow development.

Core Technical Skills

**Primary / Mandatory:**

Informatica IDMC | IICS | Cloud Data Integration (CDI) | ETL/ELT | Mapping Development | Mapping Tasks | Taskflows | SQL | Secure Agent | Data Integration | Performance Tuning

**Secondary:**

Cloud Data Quality (CDQ) | IDQ | REST/SOAP APIs | Cloud Application Integration (CAI) | Snowflake | Data Profiling | Data Cleansing

**Good to Have:**

Informatica MDM Hub | MDM Hub Console | ActiveVOS | Match & Merge | Survivorship | Trust Rules | Business Entity Services (BES) | Data Stewardship Workflows

**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Provides senior level system analysis, design, development, and implementation of applications and databases. Integrates third party products.

* Participates in design, code, and test inspections throughout the life cycle to identify issues. Explains technical considerations at related meetings, including those with internal clients. Performs systems analysis activities.
* Thoroughly understands client business functions and technology needs. Has a broad understanding of Vanguard's technologies, tools, and applications, including those that interface with business area and systems.
* Interfaces with cross functional team members, and communicates systems issues at the appropriate technical level for each audience.
* Thoroughly understands and complies with Information Technology and Information Security policies and procedures, and verifies that deliverables meet requirements.
* Participates in special projects and performs other duties as assigned.
* Lead backend system optimization efforts, ensuring high performance, scalability, and responsiveness under varying workloads.
* Spearhead the integration of multiple data sources, APIs, and services, streamlining data flow and improving overall system efficiency.
* Oversee the creation and upkeep of detailed backend documentation, helping cross-functional teams understand architecture and logic.
* Advocate and implement best practices for security, data protection, and backend resilience, aligning with enterprise-grade standards.
* Collaborate with front-end teams to design backend interfaces that support seamless and intuitive user experiences.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* A team player with strong analytical, communication and interpersonal skills
* Constantly updating yourself about new technologies in the market
* A winning personality and the ability to become a trusted advisor to the stakeholders
* Must Have skills : AWS Full stack Java required.
* Typescript

* Minimum 5 years of experience in software development, system integration, database design, and back-end architecture.
* Bachelor’s degree (B.E./B.Tech) in relevant fields such as Computer Science, or a Master’s degree/Diploma in Computer Science.
* Expertise in server-side development, system integration, and API management; strong knowledge of database design, optimization, debugging, and performance tuning.
* Must-have skills: Java, Spring Boot, Angular, Node JS, AWS, CloudFormation, ECS, Fargate, DynamoDB, S3, Lambda, IAM, SQL queries, GitHub, Bitbucket, Bamboo, CI/CD, TDD/BDD, Splunk, Honeycomb, Python.

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Strong verbal and written communication, facilitation, relationship-building, presentation and negotiation skills.
* Be highly flexible, adaptable, and creative.
* Comfortable interacting with senior executives (within the firm and at the client)

* Strong teamwork, work ethic, product mindset, client centricity and a relentless commitment to EY values.

We offer a competitive remuneration package where you’ll be rewarded for your individual and team performance. Our comprehensive Total Rewards package includes support for flexible working and career development, and with FlexEY you can select benefits that suit your needs, covering holidays, health and well-being, insurance, savings and a wide range of discounts, offers and promotions. Plus, we offer:
  
  

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career

As a member of the Identity and Access Management (IAM) team this position will contribute towards execution of an IAM roadmap that meets security requirements, including but not limited to security for customer applications using policy driven security, SSO, authentication and authorization, user provisioning/de-provisioning, and federation focusing on multiple protocols (SAML2.0, OpenID, OAuth2.0, WS-FED).

* Foster teamwork and lead by example

* Implementation experience in Web Module, Federation Module and Advance Access control module of IBAM/ISVA
* Hands-on experience with IBM ISAM WebSEAL administration, including configuration and management of various junction types, reverse proxy services.
* Experience implementing Single Sign on, Multi Factor Authentication, adaptive authentication, and customer/partner identity solutions using ISAM/ISVA.
* Working experience in application integration with header-based, SAML2.0, OIDC, OAuth2.0, WS-Fed protocols.
* Experience in implementing social login and third-party Identity Provider (IdP) integrations using ISAM/ISVA for secure authentication and federation use cases.
* Ability to design and customize authentication policies, access controls, identity workflows, and customer-facing access experiences.
* Experience in developing and integrating REST APIs, web services, and identity-related connectors to enable seamless customer and application integrations
* Ability to develop and maintain ISAM custom JavaScript mapping rules, API protection policies, and federation configurations.
* Proficiency in Java, JavaScript, and scripting technologies used for IAM customizations and automation.
* Experienced in diagnosing and resolving complex authentication, authorization, and federation issues.
* Experience in supporting platform administration activities, including upgrades, deployments, patching, and environment maintenance.
* Strong knowledge of certificate administration in ISAM, including troubleshooting SSL/TLS, signer, personal, and key database certificate-related issues.
* Understanding of IAM governance, configuration management, operational controls, and industry best practices.
* Willingness to work in a client-focused environment with flexibility to support evolving business and operational requirements.

* Understanding of latest technology such as Zero trust framework, Fine-grained authorization, Password less authentication, CIAM
* Ability to develop documentation such as business requirement document, high and low level design document, training and user procedures document.

* Strong interpersonal and presentation skills.

, Sprinto helps organizations stay audit-ready, manage real-time risks, and scale fearlessly. With

**200+ global security standards natively**
, including SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, HIPAA, PCI-DSS, and more. Sprinto's extensible architecture enables organizations to build and support an infinite number of custom integrations and frameworks.
  
  
**Founded in 2020**
by second-time founders Girish Redekar and Raghuveer Kancherla, Sprinto powers compliance for organizations like Whatfix, Encora, Anaconda, Whatnot, Ultrahuman, WeWork, Everstage, AI Foundation, HackerRank, and many more.
  
  
**Life as a Sprinter -**
Nobody succeeds at Sprinto by staying in their lane.
  
  
We are organized around problems, not job titles. Sprinters take ownership beyond their role, solve hard problems, and care deeply about the impact they create. If something can be improved, fixed, or built, we don't wait for permission; we step in.
  
  
Being remote means we rely less on proximity and more on trust. We write things down, communicate openly, and move quickly because great teams aren't built by sitting together; they're built by pulling in the same direction.
  
  
We believe progress beats perfection, feedback is a gift, and doing the right thing matters, even when nobody is watching.
  
  
And while we move with urgency, we never move alone.
  
  
**The mission -**
Autonomy is the easy half. Making it defensible is the hard half.
  
  
What the platform produces is not a suggestion that a customer can take or leave. It's used as fact by auditors and enterprise buyers whose decisions depend on us being right. Wrong in one direction, a customer loses a certification because of us. Wrong in the other, we bury them in noise until they stop reading anything we send.
  
  
Your mission is to make a defensible half, making agent judgment something a third party will accept.
  
  
**Where you'll leave your mark?**
**Agents whose output nobody re-checks.**
You'll see how we prove an agent is trustworthy: evaluation harnesses that gate releases rather than run quarterly, golden sets built with real compliance experts, regression suites assembled from production traces, and drift detection that fires before a customer notices. Not a set of scripts — a platform every other team builds on. You'll know it works when a compliance lead stops reviewing a category of output, and nothing breaks.
  
  
**A system that can prove what it said, and admit when it didn't know.**
Compliance is a claim about the past, which means state as of a date has to be held separately from when we learned it, and every artefact has to carry unbroken provenance from the source system to the audit package. The other half of the problem is honesty under failure. At several hundred connectors, partial failures are normal, and a connector returning nothing because Okta is down must never look like a control genuinely failing. Passing, failing and unknown are three different states, and that distinction has to survive all the way to the interface.
  
  
Beyond those two, there are surfaces you'll work across without owning alone: tenant isolation and enterprise identity as we move upmarket, the inference economics that decide whether continuous monitoring is viable at scale, and how we model 200 frameworks so the next one is cheap. And since every engineer here will be building with agents within a year, we'll expect the practice to be better across the org because you joined.
  
  
**The kind of builder we're looking for -**

* Someone who has built something that changed the shape of the work. Not a prototype — a system where an LLM took autonomous, multi-step action against real data and real users, and displaced something people used to do by hand. We'll want to hear what it replaced, what it cost, what its failure rate was, and how you measured it.
* An engineer who treats the model as an untrusted subsystem. Constrained outputs, independent verification, thresholds that escalate rather than guess, a clear line between what the model decides and what it only proposes. We're more interested in how your system detected and contained a bad output than in how it tried to prevent one.
* Depth in at least two of these, with room to pick up the rest here: production LLM and agent systems; temporal and provenance data modeling; high-fan-out integration reliability; multi-tenant and enterprise identity; inference cost engineering; domain modeling for messy regulatory rules.
* 10+ years building software, at least two of them at Staff scope — setting technical direction that engineers outside your reporting line followed.
* Range. Some quarters this role is an architect setting direction, some quarters it's the person taking on the problem nobody has cracked, some quarters it's carrying a team through a hard delivery. The people who do well here read what the company needs and adapt.
* Willingness to challenge how we build, and to hold the line when it counts. We're hiring partly for disagreement — on our architecture, our agent design, our standards. That includes telling go-to-market what we can't yet defend, and offering a path rather than a refusal.
* Influence without authority. Nobody on this team reports to you. Your leverage is clarity, credibility and the quality of your reasoning across Engineering, Product, Security and CX — and since we're remote-first, most of that happens in writing.

**How we care for our Sprinters?**

* Work wherever you are: We are 100% remote, so you get to choose if you want to work from home, a cafe, the hills, or the beach
* Co-working, on the house: If co-working is your jam, we offer a generous annual allowance
* We care about your learning: We are invested in seeing you grow and commit USD 1,000 annually to help you level up your skills
* We count your spark, not your leaves: Unlimited leave so you can reset when you need to
* Your Safety Net, Woven In: Health insurance with coverage up to INR 10 lakh for you and your family, accident protection of an additional INR 10 lakh, and life insurance worth 3x your annual salary
* Workspace setup of your dreams: We chip in INR 35,000 to help you build a setup that works for you

**Inclusion & Diversity -**
At Sprinto, talent, curiosity, and ownership matter more than where you come from. We hire people for the problems they can solve, the impact they create, and the way they help others succeed—not their background, identity, or personal circumstances. We believe the best teams are built when people with different perspectives come together around a shared ambition to build something meaningful.
  
  
We're proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating a fair, inclusive, and accessible hiring process for everyone.

title: Compiler Performance Engineer
description:
**Falcon**
is the optimizing just in time (JIT) compiler in Azul Platform Prime. It compiles hot Java bytecode into highly optimized machine code and delivers Java performance that standard JVMs do not reach. Falcon is built on LLVM.

  

We are looking for a
**Compiler Performance Engineer**
to make Falcon generate even faster code. This is not a compiler front end role and not a compiler built from scratch: the compiler exists, runs in production at large enterprises, and your job is to find where the generated code is slower than it should be and fix it in the optimizer and code generator.

  

You will join a distributed team of compiler experts and work on real workloads with direct, measurable impact on customer performance.

**What You Will Do (aka Responsibilities)**
  

  
* Analyze performance of Java benchmarks and customer workloads, find gaps in generated code and trace them to their root cause in the compiler
  
* Implement and improve optimizations in Falcon's middle end and back end: inlining, loop optimizations, vectorization, redundancy elimination, speculative optimizations and their interaction with the runtime
  
* Improve code generation for x86\_64 and AArch64
  
* Write tests and benchmarks that prove the improvement and protect it from regressions
  
* Contribute changes upstream to LLVM where it makes sense
  

  
**What You'll Bring (Experience, Skills)**
  

  
* 2+ years of professional experience in compilers, JIT compilers or low level performance engineering
  
* Strong C++ design and coding skills
  
* Solid understanding of compiler optimization theory: SSA, data flow analysis, loop transformations
  
* Ability to read assembly and reason about why one instruction sequence is faster than another
  

  
**Very Nice to Have**
  

  
* Experience with LLVM IR and LLVM optimization passes, or with another optimizing compiler such as HotSpot C2, Graal, GCC or V8
  
* Experience with profilers such as perf, VTune or async profiler
  
* Knowledge of x86\_64 and/or AArch64 microarchitecture
  
* Experience with Java, Scala or Kotlin, or with JVM internals
  
* MSc or PhD in Computer Science with a compiler or performance focus

title: GDS Cyber-AI Driven IAM-Manager
description:

And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**EY-Cyber Security- IAM AI Manager**
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
  
  
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
  
  
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
  
  
**About Global Delivery Services**
Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
  
  
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
  
  
Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
  
  
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
EY GDS Cybersecurity is seeking an experienced IAM AI Manager to help clients modernize their Identity and Access Management landscape through AI-led transformation. This role focuses on identifying where AI can improve IAM operations, governance, access risk management, privileged access, and non-human identity controls across enterprise environments.
  
  
You will work closely with clients and delivery teams to translate IAM challenges into practical, scalable, and reusable AI-enabled solutions. The role requires strong IAM domain understanding, consulting leadership, and the ability to shape solution approaches that improve identity lifecycle management, access governance, authentication, privileged access, compliance posture, and emerging areas such as agent, workload, and service identities.
  
  
The ideal candidate brings a strong blend of IAM experience, AI awareness, solution design capability, and stakeholder-facing communication skills. This profile is expected to guide discovery, define the IAM-AI vision, support PoCs and MVPs, and help clients adopt intelligent, risk-aware, and secure identity operations without losing focus on control, auditability, and business value.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**
**Technical architecture & design**

* Define IAM-AI solution architecture across IGA, AM/SSO, PAM, directory services, NHI, and security operations use cases.
* Translate client IAM challenges into scalable AI-enabled workflows, PoCs, MVPs, and implementation roadmaps.
* Guide secure integration of identity data, AI models, automation scripts, APIs, analytics, and cloud services to improve IAM operations and risk visibility.
* Provide hands-on direction using Python, PowerShell, APIs, and automation patterns to validate and accelerate solution delivery.

**LLM, Reasoning & Knowledge Engineering**

* Design AI-led IAM use cases using LLMs, RAG, agents, copilots, orchestration frameworks, and responsible AI guardrails.
* Apply AI/ML techniques to support access risk analysis, anomaly detection, role mining, certification insights, and privileged access intelligence.
* Support secure NHI and agent identity governance covering discovery, inventory, authentication, authorization, and guardrails.

**IAM integration automation leadership**

* Lead client workshops, discovery, solution shaping, estimation, roadmap definition, and executive-level IAM-AI storytelling.
* Design AI-enabled governance capabilities across SailPoint, Saviynt, access reviews, lifecycle management, provisioning, SOD, and compliance reporting.
* Shape PAM automation and analytics across CyberArk, privileged access patterns, session monitoring, password rotation, secrets, and risk-based remediation.
* Develop client-ready insights and dashboards using identity data, analytics, automation, and visualization tools.

**Qualifications**
**Required Skills**

* 7+ years of experience in IAM, cybersecurity consulting, AI architecture, intelligent automation, or advanced analytics.
* Strong understanding of IAM domains including IGA, AM/SSO, PAM, AD/Entra ID, NHI, lifecycle management, governance, provisioning, access reviews, and risk scoring.
* Working knowledge of AI concepts such as LLMs, RAG, AI agents, copilots, orchestration, embeddings, and cloud AI services.
* Hands-on experience with Python, PowerShell, APIs, automation scripts, data pipelines, and cloud-native integration patterns.
* Good understanding of IAM protocols and controls including SAML, OAuth, OIDC, MFA, Conditional Access, federation, authorization, and certificate/key management.
* Strong consulting, communication, stakeholder management, presentation, and executive storytelling skills.

**Preferred Skills**

* Experience in Big 4, GDS, global delivery, or consulting-led environments.
* Ability to create PoC/MVP plans, architecture views, roadmap slides, executive summaries, and client demos.
* Exposure to IAM modernization, NHI governance, privileged access transformation, AI adoption, and responsible AI controls.
* Relevant working knowledge or certifications across CISSP, CISM, Azure AI, Google ML, Saviynt, SailPoint, CyberArk, or cloud security are preferred.

**Certifications, Compliance & Assurance**

* Ensure IAM-AI solutions are secure, auditable, explainable, and aligned with client risk, compliance, and assurance expectations.
* Define governance guardrails for AI-driven identity operations, NHI controls, privileged access automation, access recommendations, data handling, and model-assisted decisions.

**What We Offer You**
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.

Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.

We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
  
  
**Benefits**
