EY's Consulting Services is a unique, industry-focused business unit that provides a broad range of integrated services that leverage deep industry experience with strong functional and technical capabilities and product knowledge. EY’s financial services practice provides integrated Consulting services to financial institutions and other capital markets participants, including commercial banks, retail banks, investment banks, broker-dealers & asset management firms, and insurance firms from leading Fortune 500 Companies. Within EY’s Consulting Practice, Data and Analytics team solves big, complex issues and capitalize on opportunities to deliver better working outcomes that help expand and safeguard the businesses, now and in the future. **The Opportunity**
The Senior Delivery Manager & Data Architect is a senior client-facing leader accountable for the end-to-end delivery and architectural integrity of complex data, analytics, cloud, and AI transformation programmes. The role combines delivery governance, commercial ownership, stakeholder leadership, and hands-on architecture oversight to translate business priorities into secure, scalable, reliable, and cost-effective data solutions.
  
  
The incumbent will act as the single point of accountability for delivery outcomes while defining target-state data architectures, engineering standards, governance controls, and transformation roadmaps. The role requires the ability to move confidently between executive discussions, programme governance, solution design, and technical assurance.

* Define enterprise data strategy, target-state architecture, reference architectures, transition states, and prioritised transformation roadmaps aligned to business and AI objectives.

* Define integration and ingestion patterns for batch, near-real-time, event-driven, CDC, API, and file-based workloads.

* Embed data quality controls, reconciliation, auditability, privacy-by-design, role-based access, encryption, and regulatory compliance into solution architecture and delivery.
* Partner with cyber security, risk, legal, compliance, and operations teams to ensure controls are demonstrable and audit-ready.
* Build trusted relationships with C-suite sponsors, business leaders, product owners, technology executives, and delivery partners.
* Translate complex business needs into clear solution options, investment cases, roadmaps, and outcome-based delivery plans.
* Facilitate executive workshops, architecture forums, steering committees, and difficult decision-making conversations.
* Own or support proposals, solution shaping, estimates, statements of work, delivery models, contract assumptions, and commercial negotiations.
* Manage programme financials, forecasting, burn, margin, resourcing, vendors, and third-party commitments.
* Identify opportunities for account growth, reusable assets, accelerators, and follow-on transformation initiatives.
* Lead multidisciplinary teams of architects, data engineers, platform engineers, analysts, data scientists, DevOps specialists, quality engineers, and project managers.
* Set clear accountabilities, create a high-performance culture, mentor senior practitioners, and develop succession and capability plans.
* Promote engineering excellence, knowledge sharing, reusable patterns, continuous improvement, and responsible use of data and AI.
* Contribute to hiring, workforce planning, communities of practice, thought leadership, and organisational capability development.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Data Science, or a related discipline.
* Typically 15+ years of technology experience, including substantial experience delivering enterprise data programmes and operating in a lead data or solution architecture capacity.
* Demonstrable ownership of large, complex, multi-team programmes with responsibility for delivery governance, senior stakeholders, budgets, quality, and commercial outcomes.
* Strong experience designing and delivering cloud data platforms on Microsoft Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud; deep expertise in at least one ecosystem is essential.
* Proven experience with modern data platforms and technologies such as Microsoft Fabric, Azure Data Factory, Azure Databricks, Synapse Analytics, Snowflake, Databricks, Spark, Kafka, cloud object storage, and modern BI tools.
* Advanced knowledge of SQL and strong working understanding of Python or PySpark, data integration, distributed processing, DevOps, CI/CD, infrastructure automation, and observability.
* Solid command of data modelling, metadata management, data quality, master data management, governance, privacy, security, and lifecycle management.
* Experience architecting AI-ready data foundations and integrating machine learning, generative AI, vector, semantic, ontology, or knowledge graph capabilities is desirable.
* Excellent executive communication, consulting, negotiation, facilitation, decision-making, and conflict-resolution skills.

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Cloud architecture or data engineering certification in Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud.
* Microsoft Fabric, Databricks, or Snowflake certification.
* TOGAF, DAMA/CDMP, or an equivalent data or enterprise architecture credential.
* PMP, PRINCE2, SAFe, Scrum, or an equivalent programme or Agile delivery certification.
* ITIL certification is advantageous for roles with service transition or operational accountability.
* Delivery against agreed outcomes, milestones, budget, quality standards, and contractual commitments.
* Architecture compliance, reduction in technical debt, and adoption of reusable standards and patterns.
* Platform reliability, performance, security, data quality, observability, and unit-cost improvement.
* Stakeholder confidence, client satisfaction, benefits realisation, and successful adoption of delivered capabilities.
* Team engagement, capability growth, predictable staffing, and development of future technical and delivery leaders.
* Commercial performance, pipeline contribution, and expansion of trusted client relationships.

**What Working At EY Offers**
At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from start–ups to Fortune 500 companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
  
  
You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. title: Mid & Senior Informatica MDM & IDQ Developer – MDM Hub & ActiveVOS
description:
Mid & Senior Informatica MDM & IDQ Developer – MDM Hub & ActiveVOS

Experience- 5–15 Years

Employment Type- Full-Time

Work Location- Remote

Notice Period- Immediate

About the Role

We are seeking an experienced Senior Informatica MDM & IDQ Developer with strong hands-on expertise in Informatica Multidomain MDM, MDM Hub Console, Informatica Data Quality (IDQ/CDQ), and ActiveVOS.

The ideal candidate should be a strong technical resource who can work directly within the MDM Hub Console, understand business requirements, configure and develop MDM solutions, build and customize match/merge and survivorship logic, and develop ActiveVOS workflows for data stewardship and approval processes.

This is a hands-on development and configuration role requiring deep knowledge of Informatica MDM architecture, MDM Hub configuration, data quality, integration, and workflow development.

Key Responsibilities

Informatica MDM Development & Configuration

* Work extensively with the Informatica MDM Hub Console for configuration, development, testing, and deployment.
* Configure and develop Base Objects, Landing Tables, Staging Tables, Mappings, Packages, Queries, Tokens, Match Rules, Merge Rules, and Trust/Survivorship Rules.
* Design and implement MDM solutions based on business and data governance requirements.
* Configure match and merge strategies, including deterministic and probabilistic matching.
* Configure trust, validation, survivorship, and consolidation rules.
* Develop and maintain Business Entity Services (BES) and associated MDM services.
* Configure and maintain Hub Jobs, batch processes, load jobs, tokenization, and cleanse processes.
* Troubleshoot data processing, matching, merging, and consolidation issues within the MDM Hub.
* Perform MDM configuration changes, enhancements, testing, and production deployments.

ActiveVOS Workflow Development

* Design, develop, configure, and maintain ActiveVOS workflows integrated with Informatica MDM.
* Develop workflows for data stewardship, approvals, exception handling, and business processes.
* Configure ActiveVOS tasks, business processes, rules, notifications, and assignments.
* Integrate ActiveVOS workflows with MDM Hub and Business Entity Services.
* Troubleshoot workflow failures, stuck tasks, integration issues, and process bottlenecks.
* Customize workflows based on changing business and data governance requirements.

Informatica Data Quality (IDQ/CDQ)

* Develop and maintain data quality mappings, transformations, cleansing, standardization, and validation rules.
* Work with profiling, scorecards, reference data, and reusable data quality components.
* Configure and maintain AddressDoctor and address cleansing/standardization processes.
* Identify data quality issues and implement appropriate remediation and cleansing strategies.
* Integrate IDQ capabilities with MDM processes to improve data accuracy and consistency.

Integration & API Development

* Develop and support integrations between Informatica MDM and upstream/downstream applications.
* Work with REST/SOAP APIs, Business Entity Services, web services, and application integrations.
* Configure and troubleshoot MDM data publishing and integration processes.
* Work with ETL/data integration processes for loading and synchronizing master data.
* Troubleshoot integration failures and performance issues across MDM and connected systems.

Production Support & Performance

* Monitor MDM processes, workflows, integrations, and scheduled jobs.
* Analyze and resolve production issues related to MDM Hub, IDQ, and ActiveVOS.
* Perform root-cause analysis and implement permanent fixes.
* Optimize match rules, mappings, queries, batch processes, and workflows for better performance.
* Coordinate with infrastructure, database, application, and vendor teams when required.

description:

**Position Summary**

* 2-4 years of hands-on experience implementing or supporting Oracle Global Trade Management (GTM) in a functional or techno-functional capacity.

familiarity with a second (Zscaler, Palo Alto Prisma Access, Forcepoint) is a strong plus.• Working knowledge of proxy configuration (PAC files, explicit vs. transparent), GRE/IPsec tunnelling, TLS/SSL inspection and routing fundamentals.• Experience deploying endpoint agents at scale via Intune, SCCM, JAMF or GPO.PREFERRED CERTIFICATIONS• Netskope Cloud Security Integrator (NCSI) or Cloud Security Administrator (NCSA).• Palo Alto PCNSE, CISSP or CCSP are a plus.COMPETENCIES & SOFT SKILLS• Comfortable walking into varied, unpredictable client environments and deploying a modern security stack on top of messy legacy networks.• Strong documentation discipline for HLD/LLDs and runbooks.• Able to run more than one client engagement at different lifecycle stages at once.WHAT WE VALUEAt Xploreteq, we value people who take responsibility, communicate openly, solve problems practically, and contribute beyond the boundaries of a job description. title: Lead Developer Advocate
description:
**Description**
**Who We Are**
Trailblazer Relations APAC is a team of creative, highly technical advocates, community builders, and program leaders. We inspire, enable, engage, and support the ever-growing Trailblazer community across Asia Pacific. We help Trailblazers succeed on the Salesforce Platform and use cutting-edge technologies like AIforce, Agentforce and Data Cloud.
  
  
Our work goes well beyond developer advocacy. We grow and support Trailblazer Community Groups, MVPs, and Group Leaders. We run community events and executive engagements. We also partner with customers, partners, and local ecosystems across the region. For developers, we write blog posts, produce video content, host workshops, and engage in person and virtually at Salesforce and third-party events.
  
  
We work closely with Trailblazer Community, Architect Evangelists, marketing, product management, engineering, and product marketing. We are the "voice of the Trailblazer" in APAC, bringing regional perspectives into the company to shape the Salesforce experience, especially around AI and data.
  
  
**Who You Are**
You're a seasoned technologist who thinks in systems. You know which tool and which feature fits the problem. That means choosing between probabilistic AI and deterministic code, and between visual builders and building from scratch. You're equally comfortable with front-end and back-end languages and APIs, and you're eager to explore new paradigms in AI-driven development.
  
  
You're curious about the full Salesforce portfolio, including platforms like MuleSoft and Heroku, and you enjoy connecting them to solve real problems. You show the "art of the possible" with prototypes that span multiple products.
  
  
You can shift between audiences, from students and new developers in emerging markets to senior architects and CTOs in mature ones. You're a lighthouse in the community, comfortable on camera and on stage in front of audiences of hundreds or thousands. You're ready to travel across APAC to meet them.
  
  
**You Are Excited About This Role Because You Will**

* Design technical content, reference apps, and demos that span AIforce, Agentforce, Data Cloud, and the wider Salesforce platform built for reuse across events and year-long regional programs.
* Collaborate with Architect Evangelists to incorporate architect content into the programs, campaigns and hands-on activities in the region.
* Contextualize global advocacy campaigns for APAC. For example, adapt one global message into narratives that work for a student-heavy market like India and an enterprise-heavy one like ANZ.
* Own the technical workstreams for flagship events such as World Tours, TDX, and Dreamforce. Design high-scale engagement models for 1000+ audiences, using gamification and interactive coding.
* Own content strategy and assets for programs such as Journey to Salesforce (J2S)
* Delegate component building while personally owning final testing and quality assurance.
* Identify gaps between product, market, and developer needs. Take real-world friction back to product and engineering as the "voice of the Trailblazer."
* Represent the team in strategic discussions, so Trailblazer and developer needs are prioritized in marketing motions.
* Coach non-technical team members, community leaders, and external presenters to deliver technical content at scale.
* Work with Community Group Leaders and MVPs to help them grow and succeed.

**We're Excited About You, Because You Have**

* 8+ years of experience implementing on the Salesforce Platform, with architect-level design skills.
* Recognized cross-product expertise, with a proven ability to build prototypes that connect multiple Salesforce products. Certifications or equivalent hands-on experience.
* Proven expertise in web applications, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, Apex, and APIs, plus hands-on curiosity about AIforce, Agentforce and Data Cloud.
* Excellent presentation, interpersonal, and communication skills, and experience making complex concepts accessible.
* Proven ability to influence without authority across regional stakeholders.
* Experience coaching and mentoring others, and a track record of raising the bar on code and content quality.
* An understanding of how quickly the ways people consume content and share experiences are shifting.
* A strategic mind and strong problem-solving and analytical skills. You work well solo and as a collaborative team player.
* Ability to travel up to 30%.

title: Principal Software Engineer, Data Platform
description:
**Ready to be a Titan?**
The Data & Reporting Platform team powers ServiceTitan’s growth by delivering high-quality, low-latency, and reliable data and BI products that enable trust, acceleration, and data-driven decision-making for our customers and across ServiceTitan.
  
  
We are looking for a Principal Engineer to own the semantic model architecture at the heart of our data platform. The semantic layer is the single source of truth for business metrics and logic, and it powers critical data products such as Reporting, and Agentic Analytics. This role sits at the intersection of data modeling, platform engineering, and product thinking — you’ll define how data is modeled, governed, and consumed at scale across multiple product surfaces.
  
  
This is a T-shaped role: deep expertise in semantic modeling and data architecture, with the breadth to operate across the full data platform stack at the principal level. You’ll partner closely with our Data Foundations team (which owns ingestion and storage), our Reporting team (which owns the reporting experience), and teams building agentic AI capabilities; ensuring the semantic layer is the performant, scalable, and extensible foundation they all depend on.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**
**Semantic Model Architecture**
: Design and evolve the semantic modeling layer that serves as the single source of truth for metrics, dimensions, entities, and business logic across all data products. Define the standards for how semantic models are authored, versioned, tested, and governed. Evaluate and drive the semantic layer technology strategy (e.g., dbt MetricFlow or equivalent).
  
  
**Data Product Enablement**
: Architect how the semantic layer is consumed across distinct product surfaces such as Reporting (high-performance BI platform for customers), and Agentic Analytics (metadata-rich, discoverable interfaces that enable AI agents to reason over and query the semantic layer). Partner with adjacent teams to ensure the semantic layer meets each product’s unique requirements.
  
  
**Performance & Scale**
: Own query performance, materialization strategies, pre-aggregation patterns, and cost optimization. Ensure the semantic layer is highly performant and scalable as data volumes and consumer demand grow.
  
  
**Platform & Governance**
: Build the semantic layer as a true platform experience: self-service metric onboarding, developer-friendly abstractions, clear documentation, data validation, and governance guardrails. Make it easy for other teams to extend the semantic layer without compromising consistency or quality.
  
  
**Technical Leadership**
: Operate as a technical leader across the Data & Reporting Platform organization. Participate in and drive design sessions across teams. Mentor engineers, manage stakeholder and leadership alignment. Contribute to architecture decisions that span from data foundations through reporting and analytics. Champion high-quality code with corresponding test coverage.
  
  
**AI-Augmented Engineering**
: Use AI coding tools (Claude, Cursor, Copilot) as a core part of your daily workflow. Drive adoption patterns, build team-specific contexts and workflows, and set the standard for how the team multiplies velocity through AI-assisted development.
  
  
**What You’ll Bring**

* 10+ years of experience in Software Engineering or Data Engineering roles, including experience with large-scale, high-traffic, fault-tolerant systems.
* Deep experience with semantic modeling, data engineering, data lakehouse, and data product development. Track record of building platform-level abstractions consumed by multiple product teams.
* Strong experience with the DBT ecosystem. Experience with semantic layer technologies (e.g., dbt MetricFlow or similar) is highly preferred.
* Expert-level SQL and Python skills. Experience with query optimization, materialization strategies, and performance tuning at scale.
* Experience with modern data platform technologies: Snowflake, ClickHouse, or similar OLAP/columnar engines. Familiarity with Spark and streaming platforms (Kafka, Kinesis).
* Experience designing APIs and interfaces for domain specific data products.
* Demonstrated proficiency with AI coding tools (eg Claude, Cursor) as part of your regular engineering workflow; not just familiarity, but active daily use.
* Experience leading the architecture and design of systems (architecture, design patterns, reliability, and scaling).
* Strong communication and technical writing skills. Ability to empathize with users and champion for their experience.
* B.S., M.S., or PhD in Computer Science or a related field.

Highly preferred
  
  
  

* Experience building semantic layers that serve both human analysts and programmatic/AI consumers.
* Experience with data governance frameworks, metric versioning, or data product catalogs.
* Familiarity with LLM-friendly data interfaces; designing schemas and metadata that enable AI agents to discover and query data effectively.
* Experience with data validation and quality frameworks (e.g., Monte Carlo, Great Expectations).

To effectively support our international teams, this position requires flexibility to overlap with US working hours as needed.
  
  
‌
  
  
**Be Human With Us:**
Being human isn’t about checking every box on a list. It’s about the experiences we have, people we meet, and the perspectives we share. So, if you have the skills but are hesitant to apply because of your background, apply anyway. We need amazing people like you to help us challenge the conventional and think differently about the problems that we’re solving. We’re in this together. Come be human, with us.
  
  
**Use of AI Technology:**
We use technology, including automated and AI-assisted tools, to support certain aspects of our recruitment process. These tools are designed to improve efficiency and enhance the candidate experience. AI tools are not used to make hiring decisions; all hiring decisions are made by our hiring teams.
  
  
At ServiceTitan, we celebrate individuality and uniqueness. We believe that the convergence of fresh perspectives and experiences from all walks of life is what makes our product and culture so great. We do not discriminate against employees based on race, color, religion, sex, national origin, gender identity or expression, age, disability, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws.

title: AVP,  Data Architect (L11)
description:
**Role Title: AVP, Data Architect (L11\)**
**Company Overview:** 
 Synchrony (NYSE: SYF) is a leading consumer financing company that has been at the heart of American commerce and opportunity for nearly a century. Synchrony delivers credit and banking products that empower tens of millions of consumers to improve their financial lives and access what matters most. Leveraging innovative solutions that are shaping the future of retail commerce, Synchrony supports the growth and success of some of the nation’s most respected brands, alongside hundreds of thousands of small and midsize businesses, including health and wellness providers. Committed to excellence in service and culture, Synchrony is proud to be named as \#3 as a Great Place to Work® in India and is honored to be ranked the \#1 Best Company to Work For® in the U.S. by Fortune magazine and Great Place to Work®. For more information, visit www.synchrony.com.
   

  

**Organizational Overview**
 Synchrony's Engineering Team is a dynamic and innovative team dedicated to driving technological excellence. As a member of this Team, you'll play a pivotal role in designing and developing cutting\-edge tech stack and solutions that redefine industry standards.
   

  

 The Credit Card that we use every day to purchase our essentials and later settle the bills \- A simple process that we all are used to on a day to day basis. Now, consider the vast complexity hidden behind this seemingly simple process, operating tirelessly for millions of cardholders. The sheer volume of data processed is mind\-boggling. Fortunately, advanced technology stands ready to automate and manage this constant torrent of information, ensuring smooth transactions around the clock, 365 days a year.
   

  

 Our collaborative environment encourages creative problem\-solving and fosters career growth. Join us to work on diverse projects, from fintech to data analytics, and contribute to shaping the future of technology. If you're passionate about engineering and innovation.
   

  

**Role Summary/Purpose**
 The AVP, Data Architect owns how data is sourced, modeled, governed, and delivered for analytic workloads, reporting/dashboarding and agentic AI solutions. The Data Architect will need to develop intimate knowledge of SYF key data domains (originations, loan activity, collection, etc.) and maintain a holistic view across SYF functions to design performant, resilient and cost\-effective data solutions.
   

  

 This role requires strong hands\-on experience for preparing data for AI data pipelines so agents can reliably access high\-quality, compliant information. The role partners closely with the data engineering team, AI Platform team, the data governance team, data science/analytics teams, and business stakeholder teams to define data architecture, standards, and operating models that enable scalable, secure, and cost\-effective analytics and AI workloads. This leader combines deep data architecture skills, strong understanding of different data model methodology, ETL pipelines, AI/LLM/RAG patterns.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Define logical, physical data model structure, integrate, govern, and store data in the enterprise repositories for supporting analytics/data science workloads, reporting/dashboarding and agentic AI workloads.
* Execute POCs and prototypes in sandbox and lab environments to propose solutions for AWS cloud workloads and AI solutions using data on AWS.
* Document data flow diagrams. Ensure discipline in the creation of Logical Data Models and their later implementation as Physical Data Structures.
* Define the target\-state Data \& AI Foundations architecture supporting agentic AI use cases, enterprise knowledge graph or metadata layer, data products, and AI\-ready datasets.
* Assist in developing the strategy and roadmap for making key enterprise data sources "AI\-ready": curation, quality, metadata, access patterns, latency requirements, and retention.
* Partner with source system owners (core servicing, CRM, collections, risk, fraud, etc.) to define data contracts, SLAs, and integration patterns that support downstream analytics.
* Establish data preparation and curation pipelines for model fine\-tuning, including dataset selection, labeling strategies, quality validation, versioning, and compliance with model risk policies.
* Define and enforce data governance policies for AI: data classification, lineage, access controls, PII handling, retention, and usage logging for AI workloads.
* Partner with AI Governance/Model Risk and InfoSec/AppSec to ensure data usage in prompts, context, and tools adheres to policies, including regulatory, privacy, and model risk requirements.
* Establish data quality and observability practices for AI data: data SLAs, freshness, completeness, drift detection, and business rule validation tied to AI outcomes.
* Drive adoption of metadata and catalog tools so platform and agent teams can discover, understand, and safely consume datasets.
* Define and oversee patterns for integrating external data (third\-party, public, partner data) into AI workflows, including licensing checks, quality assessment, and monitoring.
* Perform other duties and/or special projects as assigned.


**Qualifications/Requirements**
* Minimum 6\+ years of experience across data engineering, data architecture, or analytics platforms, with at least 3\+ years in cloud data platforms and enterprise data leadership roles.
* Strong experience with modern cloud data stacks (e.g., data warehouses like Redshift/Snowflake/BigQuery, relational databases like PostgreSQL, and object storage) and their use in analytics and AI.
* Demonstrated expertise in enabling data readiness for agentic AI from existing data stores in front\-end (OLTP) applications or analytical (OLAP) applications like data lake and warehouses. Strong hands\-on experience on designing data models (star schema, 3NF) for raw, standardized and curated data products for optimal performance and scalability of data applications for AI.
* Strong hands\-on experience in generating semantic layers for the data products that serve multiple consuming applications on AWS.
* Proven experience building data pipelines for AI/ML use cases including ETL/ELT workflows, streaming data integration, and data preparation for model training and fine\-tuning.
* Strong experience with Lakehouse architecture using S3, Apache Iceberg, Glue Data Catalog, Redshift
* Strong Python skills for building data processing, evaluation, and automation pipelines, plus familiarity with DevOps practices (CI/CD, infrastructure as code, environment management).
* Good understanding of identity and data security architecture \- IAM, IAM Identity Center, cross account data access patterns, identity propagation for AI agents and services
* Good understanding of AWS infrastructure concepts (networking, security, storage, compute) and how they apply to data and AI workloads.
* Experience working with ETL/ELT pipelines, streaming data, and integration technologies (e.g., CDC, APIs, event buses) for both batch and real\-time use cases.
* Proven ability to lead multi\-disciplinary teams and influence across platform, AI, data, and business stakeholders.


**Desired Skills/ Knowledge**
* Experience implementing or leveraging knowledge graphs, entity resolution, or semantic search to power AI and RAG use cases.
* Solid understanding of LLM and agentic AI patterns (prompts, tools, RAG, memory) and how data quality and structure impact AI behavior and performance.
* Background in building data products specifically targeted for AI/ML (feature stores, labeled datasets, evaluation datasets, fine\-tuning corpora).
* Familiarity with enterprise architecture frameworks (TOGAF) as they apply to data and AI.
* Prior experience in financial services, credit, payments, or similar domains where data lineage, explainability, and audit trails are critical.
* Basic AWS solution architecture knowledge including core services, AWS S3, Redshift, Amazon Bedrock, and Bedrock AgentCore so they can collaborate effectively with platform and agent teams.
* Good understanding of enterprise data governance and access controls like AWS Lake Formation, Glue Data catalog and metadata management frameworks.
* Team player, strong engagement, positive attitude and natural curiosity are highly desired.


**Eligibility Criteria**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or related field (or equivalent experience).
* 6\+ years of experience across data engineering, data architecture, or analytics platforms, with at least 3\+ years in cloud data platforms and enterprise data leadership roles.
* Strong familiarity with streaming through Kafka and other Data Lake technologies and techniques.
* Strong familiarity with data governance, data lineage, data processes, DML, and data architecture control execution
* Strong experience with business analysis \- Requirements analysis and conversion to data models.
* Must be able to develop creative solutions to problems.


**Work Timings: 2:00 PM to 11:00 PM IST**
 This role qualifies for Enhanced Flexibility offered in Synchrony India and will require the incumbent to be available between 06:00 AM Eastern Time – 11:30 AM Eastern Time (timings are anchored to US Eastern hours and will adjust twice a year locally). This window is for meetings with India and US teams. The remaining hours will be flexible for the employee to choose. title: EY - GDS Consulting - AIA - Mainframe - Manager
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**The opportunity**
 We are seeking an experienced Manager – Mainframe Modernization to lead our AI\-Driven Legacy Transformation practice. The ideal candidate will bring deep expertise across mainframe ecosystems, AI/ML\-driven modernization strategies, and cloud technologies, combined with strong leadership, stakeholder management, and team\-building capabilities to deliver large\-scale digital transformation programmes.
   

  

 You will own the end\-to\-end modernization strategy, drive cross\-functional collaboration with C\-suite leaders, business stakeholders, and architecture teams, and lead a team of engineers and specialists to successfully migrate mission\-critical mainframe workloads to modern, scalable, cloud\-native platforms using AI\-powered automation frameworks.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
**Technical Excellence:**
* Strategic Leadership and Stakeholder Management
+ Define and own the mainframe modernization strategy aligned with business objectives and enterprise technology roadmaps.
+ Collaborate with senior stakeholders, business leaders, and architecture teams to prioritise modernization initiatives and secure executive buy\-in.
+ Evaluate and recommend modernization paths — rehosting, refactoring, rebuilding, or replacing — based on cost\-benefit analysis, risk assessment, and business impact.

* Mainframe Systems Assessment and Governance
+ Oversee comprehensive assessments of mainframe applications (COBOL, JCL, VSAM, DB2, CICS, IMS, Assembler) to identify modernization opportunities, risks, and dependencies.
+ Establish governance frameworks, quality gates, and standards for modernization delivery across the portfolio.
+ Drive technical debt identification, quantification, and systematic reduction across the legacy estate.

* AI\-Driven Modernization and Automation
+ Champion the adoption of AI tools, LLMs, and custom AI agentic workflows for automated code analysis, refactoring, and code translation at scale.
+ Define and operationalise AI pipelines, prompt engineering standards, and context engineering best practices to maximise modernization throughput and accuracy.
+ Evaluate emerging AI/ML technologies and integrate them into the modernization toolchain to maintain competitive advantage.

* Team Leadership and Capability Building
+ Lead, mentor, and grow a team of mainframe modernization engineers, developers, and analysts.
+ Build team capabilities in AI\-driven modernization, cloud\-native development, and DevOps practices.
+ Conduct architecture reviews, code reviews, and provide technical guidance to ensure delivery excellence.

* Target\-State Architecture – APIs and Microservices
+ Architect and oversee the design of target\-state systems, including API integrations, microservices, and event\-driven architectures.
+ Ensure modernized solutions are scalable, resilient, and aligned with enterprise architecture standards.

* Cloud and Platform Integration
+ Lead the migration of mainframe workloads to cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud) using AI\-driven and automated solutions.
+ Ensure seamless integration of legacy systems with cloud\-native services, containerised deployments (Docker, Kubernetes), and CI/CD pipelines.
+ Drive adoption of infrastructure\-as\-code, observability, and security best practices for modernized workloads.

* Reporting, Documentation, and Business Impact
+ Create and present executive\-level reporting on modernization progress, business impact, risks, and ROI.
+ Maintain comprehensive technical documentation including system designs, AI pipeline architectures, and modernization roadmaps.
+ Track and communicate KPIs related to migration velocity, quality, cost savings, and operational efficiency.


**Skills and Attributes:**
* Educational Background
* Bachelor / master’s degree in computer science, AI, Any Engineering or quantitative background preferred.


**Professional Experience**
* 10\+ years of experience with legacy mainframe systems (COBOL, JCL, Assembler, CICS, DB2, IMS, VSAM) with at least 3–4 years in a leadership or managerial capacity.
* Proven track record of leading large\-scale mainframe modernization or digital transformation programmes.
* Deep expertise in data migration, integration, ETL, and cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud).
* Strong proficiency in programming/scripting languages (Python, Java, etc.).
* Expert\-level knowledge of APIs, microservices architecture, and containerization (Docker, Kubernetes).
* Extensive experience with AI tools, LLM API calls, prompt engineering, and context engineering for automating code analysis and modernization workflows.
* Experience with enterprise modernization platforms (Micro Focus, AWS Mainframe Modernization, Azure Migrate, Google Cloud Dual Run) is a plus.
* Hands\-on experience building or managing AI/ML pipelines for code transformation at scale.


**Soft Skills**
* Exceptional client engagement and stakeholder management skills.
* Strong problem\-solving skills with the ability to translate complex business requirements into practical, high\-quality technical solutions.
* Excellent communication, presentation, and leadership abilities.
* Experience with Agile/SAFe delivery methodologies and managing distributed/global teams.


**Preferred Certifications**
* Cloud certifications (AWS/Azure/GCP), AI/ML certifications, enterprise architecture (TOGAF), or mainframe\-related certifications are a plus.


**Why Join Us**
* Be at the forefront of AI\-driven mainframe modernization across enterprise clients.
* Work with global clients to drive real business impact through large\-scale digital transformation.
* Collaborate with a team of modernization experts, AI specialists, and industry leaders in a highly innovative and entrepreneurial environment.


**What We Offer**
 EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, serving our clients locally and globally with innovation and at scale.
   

  

* Continuous learning: You'll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* Success as defined by you: We'll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* Transformative leadership: We'll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* Diverse and inclusive culture: You'll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Tech & Data - System Transformation Data - Manager
description:
The Opportunity
   

  

 Join our Acceleration Center India and help shape the future of business for our diverse client portfolio across geographies and jurisdictions. You’ll work at the heart of global teams across Advisory, Assurance, Tax and Business Services—solving real client challenges through connected collaboration. We’ll help you grow your skills so you can go further. With hands\-on learning, cutting\-edge tools and an inclusive culture, this is your opportunity to do inspiring work that makes a difference—every day.
   

  

 As a Tech \& Data \- System Transformation Data \- Manager, you will play a pivotal role in assisting clients to develop solutions that enhance trust, drive improvement, and manage risk through advanced analytics and technology. Within our Assurance practice, you will focus on providing independent assessments of financial statements and internal controls, enhancing the credibility of information for stakeholders.
   

  

 As a Manager, you will lead teams and manage client accounts, focusing on strategic planning and mentoring junior staff. You are accountable for project success and maintaining standards. Enhancing your leadership style, you motivate, develop, and inspire others to deliver quality. You are responsible for coaching, leveraging team members' unique strengths, and managing performance to deliver on client expectations. With your growing knowledge of how business works, you play an important role in identifying opportunities that contribute to the success of our Firm. You are expected to lead with integrity and authenticity, articulating our purpose and values in a meaningful way. You embrace technology and innovation to enhance your delivery and encourage others to do the same.
   

  

 In this role at PwC Acceleration Center India, you will utilize data wrangling technology and automation tools to establish processes that enable clients to make informed decisions based on accurate and trustworthy information.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Understanding Data Migration, data governance and data analytics.
* Experience / Exposure to System Transformation (Pre / Post Implementation)Projects for Audit / Non\-Audit clients
* Ability to leverage and possess hands\-on working knowledge of visualization software such as Power BI.
* Applying knowledge of data analysis and manipulation products like SQL, Alteryx, Python, and Databricks.
* Engaging in regulation, workforce, financial reporting, and automation.
* Managing complex internal and external stakeholder relationships.
* Thriving in a dynamic consulting environment, with a desire to grow within this setting.
* Managing client engagements and internal projects, including budgets, risks, and quality assurance.
* Preparing reports and deliverables for clients and other stakeholders.
* Developing and maintaining internal and external relationships.
* Identifying and pursuing business opportunities, supporting line management in proposal development, and managing, coaching, and supporting team members.
* Supporting team with engagement scoping and planning activities.
* Coaching team members in task completion.
* Performing advanced data analysis to support test procedures.
* Collaborating effectively with local and regional teams and clients.
* Supporting team in drafting client deliverables for review by Engagement Leaders.
* Managing project economics for engagement teams.
* Conducting basic review activities and providing coaching to junior team members.
* Demonstrates strong critical\-thinking ability to evaluate not just the presence of documentation but its quality, clarity, and completeness—proactively identifying gaps, inconsistencies, and opportunities for improvement.


 What You Must Have
   

  

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering and Business, Financial Mathematics, Mathematical Economics, Quantitative Finance, Statistics, or a related field.
* Minimum Years of Experience: 7\+ years of relevant experience, preferably in a public accounting firm or a large corporation
* 3 years of assurance experience in internal controls and/or business process testing.
* Experience in technology risk (e.g., IT General Controls, information security).
* Previous experience in shared service delivery centers.
* Certifications such as CIA, CISA, or ITIL are preferred.


 What Sets You Apart
   

  

* Advanced knowledge and understanding of financial risk management, operational risk management, and compliance requirements.
* Proficiency in data analytics tools (e.g., Alteryx, Power BI) and Microsoft suite tools (e.g., Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
* Experience with major ERPs such as SAP, Oracle, and/or technology security management.
* Programming skills in SQL, Python, or R.
* Accounting experience and consulting experience.
* Knowledge in financial services is preferable.
* Strong analytical skills with high attention to detail and accuracy.
* Excellent verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills.
* Ability to work both independently and within a team environment.

title: SAP ABAP on HANA Developer (8 to 10 years) - Kolkata
description:
We are hiring an experienced Lead SAP ABAP on HANA Developer (8 to 10 years) for Kolkata.
 



  





 Role Details\-
 



 • Role: SAP ABAP on HANA Developer
 



 • Experience: 8 to 10 Years
 



 • Location: Kolkata
 



 • Notice Period: Immediate to 15 days max
 



  





 What you will be working on:
 



 • Developing and enhancing ABAP programs in SAP S/4HANA utilizing modern code\-pushdown techniques, CDS Views, and AMDP.
 



 • Designing and building end\-to\-end RICEFW objects (Reports, Interfaces, Conversions, Enhancements, and Forms).
 



 • Creating, customizing, and maintaining ABAP Data Dictionary (DDIC) objects including tables, views, structures, data elements, and domains.
 



 • Developing and consuming OData services for UI integration, alongside building complex ALV reports, Smart Forms, and Adobe Forms.
 



 • Conducting code reviews, performance tuning, and debugging aligned with SAP S/4HANA clean core standards.
 



  





 What we are looking for:
 



 • 8 to 10 years of strong hands\-on development experience in SAP ABAP and ABAP on HANA / S/4HANA.
 



 • Solid expertise in CDS Views, AMDP, and code optimization strategies.
 



 • Proven track record delivering standard and custom RICEFW solutions across core functional modules.
 



 • Hands\-on proficiency in OData service implementation and Adobe Forms / Smart Forms design.
 



 • Strong debugging, performance optimization, and analytical skills.
 



 • Excellent verbal and written communication abilities.
 



  





 How to Apply:
 



 Please email your resume directly to: rmt@gruenbleen.com
 



  





 Email Subject Line format:
 



 SAP ABAP Developer \- Kolkata \- \[Your Name] \- \[Experience] \- \[Notice Period]
 



  





 \#SAPABAP \#ABAPonHANA \#SAPS4HANA \#CDSViews \#AMDP \#OData \#AdobeForms \#RICEFW \#KolkataJobs \#Hiring \#ImmediateJoiner

title: Digital-Senior
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**Service line \- Position Title:**
 At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
   

  

 We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
   

  

 Join EY and help to build a better working world.
   

  

**About Global Delivery Services**
 Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
   

  

 Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000\+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
   

  

 Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy \& Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high\-quality, value\-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
   

  

 Enablement Services provides cost\-effective, high\-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
   

  

 Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
   

  

**The Opportunity**
 We are looking for a Senior AI Engineer with 4\-8 years of overall experience to design, build, and deploy production\-grade AI systems. The ideal candidate has strong hands\-on expertise in Python, Generative AI and Agentic AI, backed by a solid foundation in Machine Learning, Deep Learning, NLP, and Transformer architectures. This is a hands\-on role where you will be expected to operate as a strong individual contributor while also being able to work at a lead capacity, engaging directly stakeholders to translate business needs into scalable technical solutions.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Own features end\-to\-end, from problem framing and model development to API design, deployment, and scaling on the cloud.
* Design, build, and deploy production\-grade AI systems.
* Engage directly with stakeholders to translate business needs into scalable technical solutions.
* Design and develop REST/APIs and integrate AI models into services.
* Scale applications and optimize performance for high\-volume workloads.
* Deploy and operate models/services in production environments (CI/CD, containerization, monitoring).
* Operate as a strong individual contributor and lead at a stakeholder engagement capacity.
* Guide and mentor junior engineers.


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, Engineering, or a related field.
* 4\-8 years of overall hands\-on experience in software/AI engineering (not limited to Generative AI).
* Proven track record of delivering production\-grade AI/ML solutions.
* Very strong proficiency in Python and its AI/ML ecosystem.
* Solid hands\-on experience with Generative AI (LLMs, prompt engineering, RAG, embeddings, fine\-tuning).
* Strong foundation in Machine Learning and Deep Learning concepts and techniques.
* Good working knowledge of NLP and Transformer\-based architectures.
* Production\-grade experience designing and developing REST/APIs and integrating AI models into services.
* Demonstrated experience in scaling applications and optimizing performance for high\-volume workloads.
* Hands\-on experience with Microsoft Azure cloud services.
* Experience in deploying and operating models/services in production environments (CI/CD, containerization, monitoring).

title: iScala Analyst
description:
iScala ERP Analyst
   

  

 At Johnson Controls, you will join a global organization focused on helping customers improve performance, safety, and efficiency across critical environments. In this role, you will support iScala ERP users and help keep core business processes running smoothly through reliable functional support, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement.
   

  

 Role Overview
   

  

 The iScala ERP Analyst will provide day\-to\-day application support across iScala ERP and connected solutions, helping users resolve issues, maintain stable operations, and improve how the system supports business processes. This role is well suited for someone with 4\-6 years of hands\-on experience in ERP support or techno\-functional analysis who enjoys solving problems, working with cross\-functional teams, and supporting end users in a fast\-paced environment.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Provide functional support for iScala ERP users and resolve application issues, service requests, and support tickets.
* Support troubleshooting and hyper care activities across iScala ERP and the Edge Apps ecosystem.
* Work with business and technical teams to analyze issues, identify root causes, and coordinate fixes or workarounds.
* Assist with functional deployment across Build, SIT, UAT, and end\-user training activities.
* Support localization, electronic invoicing, advanced functions, and statutory or regulatory compliance needs within the ERP environment.
* Develop and maintain reports, interfaces, and workflow integrations using relevant Epicor and database technologies.
* Document solutions, user guidance, and support outcomes to improve system understanding and future issue resolution.
* Contribute to upgrades, testing, and process improvements that strengthen overall ERP performance.


 How You Will Do It
   

  

* You will take ownership of issues end to end, working with urgency and accuracy to restore service and support business continuity.
* You will stay close to the work by partnering with users, understanding process flows, and removing obstacles before they affect customers or operations.
* You will use structured problem\-solving and root cause analysis to move beyond quick fixes and help prevent repeat issues.
* You will collaborate openly across functional and technical teams, sharing knowledge and contributing to solutions that improve the system for everyone.
* You will look for continuous improvements in support, documentation, testing, and automation so the ERP environment becomes more efficient over time.


**Qualifications**
* 4\-6 years of experience in iScala ERP support, techno\-functional analysis, or a similar ERP application support role.
* Strong hands\-on knowledge of iScala ERP and related business processes.
* Experience supporting functional configuration, troubleshooting, deployment, and user issue resolution.
* Working knowledge of MS SQL Server 2019, SQL Programming, SSRS Report Development, and SSIS Development.
* Experience with database management, complex SQL scripting, and investigation of ERP interfaces.
* Familiarity with Epicor Service Connect or similar integration tools is strongly valued.
* Ability to communicate clearly with users and cross\-functional stakeholders in English.
* Strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and the ability to work independently as well as part of a team.


 Nice to Have
   

  

* Experience supporting iScala localization, electronic invoicing, or compliance\-related ERP functions.
* Prior exposure to hyper care support, system upgrades, Build/SIT/UAT cycles, or end\-user training.
* Experience creating user documentation, support guides, or process notes for business users.


 Why Join Us
   

  

 You will be part of a collaborative environment where your work directly supports business users and operational stability. Johnson Controls offers a competitive salary and benefits package, along with opportunities for professional growth and development.
   

  

 If you are ready to bring your iScala ERP experience to a role where your problem\-solving skills can make a real impact, we would love to hear from you.
